Drawing on insights from interpreting studies, we identify critical dimensions of professional interpreting practice that are overlooked by current systems, and consolidate them into three interdependent design priorities for future MI: \emph{agency} (context-sensitive initiative and repair), \emph{grounding} (multimodal and discourse-level situational awareness), and \emph{experience} (adaptive improvement through real interaction). Together, these priorities chart a path toward closing the usability gap and enabling systems that can sustain authentic multilingual communication in real time.

</details>


### [314] [Who Flips? Self- and Cross-Model Counterarguments Reveal Answer Instability in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16011)
*Nafiseh Nikeghbal,Amir Hossein Kargaran,Shaghayegh Kolli,Jana Diesner*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种评估大语言模型答案稳定性的控制协议，通过在有说服力的反论挑战下测量模型是否改变正确答案。对7个前沿模型和57个MMLU主题的测试显示，模型翻转率在17.5%到97.3%之间，自归因平均增加7.1个百分点翻转率，跨模型选择最有效反驳可进一步提升挑战强度。作者发布了MaxFlip挑战集及相关资源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有准确率基准测试只衡量模型能否接近正确答案，但无法评估模型在面临合理反论时是否坚持正确回答。作者希望填补这一评估空白，引入答案稳定性作为新的评估维度。

Method: 设计控制协议：模型先回答多项选择题，然后用连贯的论点挑战模型选择错误选项，同时隔离论点内容与社交压力因素，并变化论点长度、自归因属性和跨模型来源。使用7个前沿模型在57个MMLU主题上进行实验。

Result: 翻转率在17.5%~97.3%之间；自归因一致增加翻转率（平均+7.1pp，最高+18.7pp）；跨模型选择最有效反驳比单一模型更强；构建的MaxFlip挑战集相比标准自生成挑战提升翻转率最多+23.6pp。

Conclusion: 准确率指标无法捕捉模型在挑战下的稳定性差异，答案稳定性应作为独立评估维度；本文提出的协议和MaxFlip数据集可用于补充标准准确率基准测试。

Abstract: Standard accuracy benchmarks are designed to test how closely large language models (LLMs) approach correct answers, but are not suitable for testing whether LLMs stick with a correct answer when that answer is challenged by a plausible counter-argument. We introduce a controlled protocol for evaluating answer stability: after a model answers a multiple-choice question correctly, we challenge the model's answer with a coherent argument for an incorrect option and measure whether the model flips. The setup a) isolates argumentative content from overt social pressure and b) varies argument length, self-attribution, and cross-model source. Across seven frontier models and 57 MMLU subjects, flip rates range from 17.5% to 97.3%, revealing large differences in stability that are not captured by accuracy metrics alone. We find that self-attribution consistently increases flip rates (mean +7.1pp, up to +18.7pp). Also, pooling wrong-answer arguments across models and selecting the most effective one per question yields stronger adversarial challenges than relying on any single source model. We further construct MaxFlip, a curated challenge set that amplifies flips by up to +23.6pp over standard self-generated challenges. We release the protocol, challenge records, and MaxFlip to support stability evaluation alongside standard accuracy benchmarks. Materials are available at https://github.com/nafisenik/WhoFlips and https://hf.co/datasets/nafisehNik/WhoFlips.

</details>


### [315] [Scaling Human and G2P Supervision for Robust Phonetic Transcription](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16019)
*Alexander Metzger,Aruna Srivastava,Ruslan Mukhamedvaleev*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本研究探究了自动音标转录性能如何随人类标注和G2P监督规模变化。基于包含标准、非标准及卒中后言语的80小时基准测试，发现G2P监督仅在人类标注少于20-30小时时有效，超过该阈值无显著收益甚至降低跨方言鲁棒性。超过阈值后，ASR预训练可实现2.3倍的加权音素特征错误率降低，尤其对非母语和失语症语音效果显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 专家音标标注成本高昂，尤其对于非标准方言和非典型言语。自动音标转录的规模化应用需要明确不同监督策略（人类标注与G2P模型）的性能边界和适用条件。

Method: 构建了包含母语、非母语和卒中后言语的80小时基准测试集，系统比较了人类标注量、G2P监督和ASR预训练对自动音标转录性能的影响，识别出监督质量阈值。

Result: 发现监督质量阈值：人类标注少于20-30小时时G2P监督有效；超过该阈值G2P无显著帮助且可能降低跨方言鲁棒性。ASR预训练在超过阈值后有效，实现2.3倍加权音素特征错误率降低。

Conclusion: 数量驱动的G2P扩展在鲁棒泛化方面收益递减，超过特定阈值后应转向ASR预训练等替代策略。

Abstract: Expert phonetic annotation is costly, especially for non-standard dialects and atypical speech. A common alternative is using Grapheme-to-Phoneme (G2P) models to auto-generate phonetic labels from text transcripts at scale. We study how automatic phonetic transcription performance scales with human and G2P supervision in English. Using a curated 80-hour benchmark spanning native, non-native and post-stroke speech, we identify a supervision quality threshold: G2P supervision helps only when fewer than 20-30 hours of human annotation are available. Beyond this threshold, it provides no significant benefit and can reduce cross-dialect robustness. What is effective after this threshold is ASR pretraining which we use to achieve a 2.3x reduction in weighted phone feature error rate over prior systems, with strong gains on non-native and aphasic speech. These results suggest that quantity-driven G2P scaling may yield diminishing returns for robust generalization.

</details>


### [316] [In-Domain Supervised Pathology Report Classification: A Reproducible Pipeline from Data Curation to Production-Matched Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16026)
*Isaac Hands,Bin Huang,Adam Spannaus,John Gounley,Heidi Hanson,Eric Durbin,Sally R. Ellingson*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向域内的监督流水线，通过标准化数据筛选、生产匹配的保留集和盲审机制，有效解决了病理报告模型在不同癌症登记机构间迁移时的分布外性能下降问题，在肯塔基模型上实现了FNR 0.003和F1 0.922的显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决监督式生物医学NLP模型在不同癌症登记机构间迁移时出现的分布外（out-of-distribution）性能下降问题，即模型在病理报告训练集上表现良好，但迁移到其他登记机构时性能显著退化。

Method: 提出一种可复现的域内监督流水线，包括：(1) 利用常规收集的癌症登记数据构建域内训练集和生产匹配的保留集；(2) 采用设施分层采样（facility-stratified sampling）标准化数据筛选，并分别处理与登记病例关联的报告；(3) 通过选择操作点（operating points）在保持极低假阴性率（FNR）的同时控制审阅者工作量；(4) 实施盲审（blinded manual audit）估计阳性病例流行率和标签噪声。

Result: 在418k报告保留集上，肯塔基模型达到FNR 0.003、FPR 0.097，优于西雅图训练的MOSSAIC OncoID基线（FNR 0.010, FPR 0.183），F1从0.860提升至0.922。盲审600份报告显示，估计阳性流行率从0.500降至0.398，表明存在显著标签噪声，且错误集中在罕见原发部位。

Conclusion: 该域内监督流水线能有效缓解跨癌症登记机构的分布外性能下降，通过标准化数据构建和盲审机制显著提升模型泛化能力，同时揭示了标签噪声对性能评估的影响。

Abstract: We introduce an in-domain supervised pipeline designed to counter the out-of-distribution performance drop that hampers supervised biomedical NLP models, a problem observed when models trained on pathology reports are moved across cancer registries. Our contribution is a reproducible recipe for training a supervised classifier from routinely collected cancer registry data. It describes how to build the in-domain training set and a production-matched holdout, and to choose operating points that keep the false-negative rate (FNR) very low while keeping reviewer workload manageable. The pipeline standardizes data curation with facility-stratified sampling and separate handling of reports linked to registry cases, and includes a blinded manual audit to estimate positive-case prevalence and label noise. On a 418k-report holdout set, the Kentucky model achieved FNR 0.003 and false-positive rate (FPR) 0.097, improving over the Seattle-trained MOSSAIC OncoID baseline (FNR 0.010, FPR 0.183) and raising F1 from 0.860 to 0.922. In a blinded manual review of 600 reports, estimated positive prevalence declined from 0.500 to 0.398, indicating substantial label noise with errors concentrated in rare primary sites.

</details>


### [317] [From Argument Components to Graphs: A Multi-Agent Debate with Confidence Gating for Argument Relations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16047)
*Jakub Bąba,Jarosław A. Chudziak*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一种选择性辩论框架，将多智能体辩论范式扩展到论点关系识别与分类（ARIC）任务中，通过置信度门控机制仅对不确定样本进行辩论，在UKP语料库上实现了训练自由方法中最佳的Macro F1，同时提供了可解释的辩论记录。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准训练自由的LLM在论点挖掘中难以捕捉需要联合分析两段文本的细微细节，且自纠错机制会强化初始幻觉。现有监督微调成本高昂，而多智能体辩论范式在组件分类任务中展现出潜力，但尚未在ARIC任务上得到验证。

Method: 1) 将ARIC任务重构为组件对间的辩论；2) 采用Proponent-Opponent-Judge多智能体架构进行辩证优化；3) 引入置信度门控机制，仅对低置信度样本进行辩论，高置信度样本直接接受初始预测。

Result: 在UKP论点注释论文v2语料库上，选择性辩论在所有训练自由方法中取得最高Macro F1；全样本辩论反而低于基线；所有生成式方法在Macro F1上均超越微调RoBERTa模型。

Conclusion: 选择性辩论框架有效提升了训练自由方法在ARIC任务上的性能，且可解释性强；Attack类别的欠表征对监督微调的损害大于仅推理模型，说明生成式方法在处理类别不平衡时具有优势。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly assessed and utilized in the field of Argument Mining (AM), thanks to their strong general reasoning capabilities. However, standard training-free models often miss sophisticated details, specifically in contexts where two parts of the text have to be analyzed together. Furthermore, self-correction mechanisms tend to reinforce initial hallucinations in reasoning. Overcoming these limitations typically requires expensive, domain-specific supervised fine-tuning. Recent work has shown that a multi-agent paradigm can address such weaknesses for the component classification task through dialectical refinement with a Proponent-Opponent-Judge architecture, setting a promising direction for training-free approaches in the field. In this paper, we extend and evaluate this framework on the Argument Relation Identification and Classification (ARIC) task, reformulating it as a debate over component pairs. Besides that, we introduce a confidence gating mechanism that enables debating only on the uncertain cases and accepting the initial prediction when confidence is high. On the UKP Argument Annotated Essays v2 corpus, we demonstrate that the selective debate achieves the highest Macro F1 among all training-free methods, while debate over all samples degrades performance below that of one of the baselines. All generative approaches also outperform fine-tuned RoBERTa models on Macro F1, suggesting that the under-representation of the Attack class was more damaging to supervised fine-tuning than to inference-only models. Additionally, our framework produces human-readable debate transcripts, offering interpretability absent from both single-agent and supervised classifiers.

</details>


### [318] [PVminerLLM2: Improving Structured Extraction of Patient Voice via Preference Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16074)
*Samah Fodeh,Linhai Ma,Ganesh Puthiaraju,Srivani Talakokkul,Afshan Khan,Elyas Irankhah,Sreeraj Ramachandran,Ashley Hagaman,Sarah Lowe,Aimee Roundtree*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出PVminerLLM2，通过偏好优化方法改进结构化患者语音提取，解决了监督微调在细粒度、罕见错误上的局限，在多个指标上优于基线模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 患者生成的文本包含关键医疗信息但非结构化，现有监督微调（SFT）方法在处理稀疏、细粒度且分布不均的标记级错误时效果不佳，特别是在标记关键的结构化输出中。

Method: 提出PVminerLLM2模型，核心创新包括：(i) 引入带标记级门控稳定项（token-level gated stabilization term）的偏好目标，防止偏好优化下绝对标记似然度退化；(ii) 混淆感知偏好对构建（confusion-aware preference pair construction），更好捕捉低区分度差异；(iii) 结合标记重要性加权和逆频率重加权，处理标记不平衡和类别偏斜问题。

Result: 在多个模型规模上，PVMinerLLM2持续优于强基线模型，在Code、Sub-code和Span指标上分别提升最多4.43%、3.50%和1.55%，且优于使用现有偏好优化方法训练的基线LLM。

Conclusion: 偏好优化能有效弥补监督微调在结构化患者语音提取任务中的不足，所提出的门控稳定项和混淆感知构建方法为提升标记级结构化输出的准确性提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Motivation: Patient-generated text contains critical information on patients' lived experiences, social context, and care engagement, but remains largely unstructured, limiting its use in patient-centered outcomes research. Prior work introduced the PV-Miner benchmark and PVMinerLLM models for structured extraction. However, supervised fine-tuning (SFT) alone struggles with rare, fine-grained, and unevenly distributed errors, particularly in token-critical structured outputs.
  Results: We present PVminerLLM2, an improved set of LLMs for structured patient voice extraction that applies preference optimization to address token-critical errors beyond the reach of supervised fine-tuning. Our method introduces (i) a preference objective with token-level gated stabilization term that prevents degradation of absolute token likelihood under preference optimization, and (ii) confusion-aware preference pair construction to better capture low-separation distinctions. We further incorporate token-importance weighting and inverse-frequency reweighing to address token imbalance and class skew. Across multiple model sizes, PVMinerLLM2 consistently outperforms strong baselines, achieving gains of up to 4.43% (Code), 3.50% (Sub-code), and 1.55% (Span), and outperforms baseline LLM trained with existing preference optimization methods.
  Availability and Implementation: The supplementary material, code, evaluation scripts, and trained models for PVminerLLM2 are publicly available at: https://github.com/Data-Mining-Lab-Yale/PVminerLLM2

</details>


### [319] [Long-Context Modeling via GSS-Transformer Hybrid Architecture with Learnable Mixing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16093)
*Kuzey Torlak,Hüseyin Arda Arslan,Anıl Dervişoğlu,Beyza Nur Deniz,Onur Boyar*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出并行混合架构PHA，将门控状态空间模型、分组查询注意力和前馈网络作为独立并行分支运行，通过可学习混合机制融合，在保持Transformer级困惑度的同时显著提升长序列建模效率（24%吞吐量提升，40%内存降低）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer的自注意力机制随序列长度二次方增长，而状态空间模型（SSM）虽线性伸缩但存在选择性召回瓶颈，难以从压缩状态中精确检索信息。现有方法存在效率与困惑度之间的根本性权衡。

Method: 提出PHA并行混合架构，包含三个独立并行分支：门控状态空间（GSS）捕获全局上下文、分组查询注意力（GQA）执行选择性检索、前馈网络（FFN）提供互补处理，通过可学习混合机制融合各分支输出。

Result: WikiText-103上125M参数取得16.51 PPL，优于Hedgehog(16.70)和H3-125M(23.70)；180M参数达16.42 PPL，与纯注意力基线相当，但吞吐量提升24%、长上下文内存降低40%。OpenWebText上125M模型达19.72 PPL，优于标准Transformer(20.60)和GSS混合基线(19.80)。

Conclusion: 将序列建模范式分离为并行专家分支，可在保持Transformer级困惑度的同时显著提升长上下文语言建模的效率，有效打破效率与困惑度之间的权衡。

Abstract: Modeling long-range dependencies remains a central challenge in natural language processing. Transformer architectures achieve strong performance via self-attention but scale quadratically ($O(N^2)$) with sequence length, while State Space Models (SSMs) scale linearly ($O(N)$) but suffer from a selective recall bottleneck, struggling to retrieve precise information from compressed states. This creates a fundamental tradeoff between efficiency and perplexity. To tackle these challenges, we propose the \textit{Parallel Hybrid Architecture (PHA)}, which runs Gated State Spaces (GSS), Grouped Query Attention (GQA), and Feed-Forward Networks (FFNs) as independent parallel branches fused by a learnable mixing mechanism. Instead of forcing SSMs to approximate attention or serializing the two paradigms, PHA allows each branch to specialize: GSS captures global context, while attention performs selective retrieval, with FFN providing complementary processing. On WikiText-103, PHA achieves 16.51 PPL at 125M parameters, outperforming Hedgehog (16.70) and H3-125M (23.70). Scaling to 180M parameters yields 16.42 PPL, which gives comparable results with the pure attention baseline while delivering 24\% higher throughput and up to 40\% lower memory usage at long contexts. On OpenWebText, our 125M model achieves 19.72 PPL, outperforming standard Transformers (20.60) and GSS hybrid baselines (19.80). These results demonstrate that separating sequence modeling paradigms into parallel specialists enables Transformer-level perplexity with substantially improved efficiency for long-context language modeling.

</details>


### [320] [Towards Pareto-Optimal Tool-Integrated Agents with Pareto Ranking Policy Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16111)
*Junyi Li,Xiaowei Qian,Yingyi Zhang,Wenlin Zhang,Guojing Li,Sheng Zhang,Xiao Han,Yichao Wang,Xiangyu Zhao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出ParetoPO，一个两阶段多目标优化框架，用于对齐工具集成型大语言模型，在准确性和工具使用效率等竞争目标间实现帕累托最优权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对齐方法主要关注最大化任务准确率，忽略了工具使用效率等对实际部署至关重要的辅助目标，缺乏在多竞争目标下进行优化的方法。

Method: ParetoPO包含两阶段：(1) 超体积引导的动态标量化，根据全局帕累托前沿进展自适应调整奖励权重；(2) 基于帕累托排序的优势计算，通过优势感知的信用分配促进非支配轨迹，实现细粒度动作级优化。

Result: 在数学推理和多跳问答任务上，ParetoPO相比静态和启发式基线方法，能够发现具有更优准确率-效率权衡的策略。

Conclusion: ParetoPO有效解决了工具集成LLM在多竞争目标下的对齐问题，实现了更优的准确率与效率权衡，具有实际部署价值。

Abstract: Recent advances in tool-integrated language agents have significantly improved their ability to solve complex reasoning tasks. However, existing alignment methods predominantly focus on maximizing task accuracy, while overlooking auxiliary objectives such as tool-use efficiency, which are essential for practical deployment. To address this gap, we introduce ParetoPO, a two-stage multi-objective optimization framework for aligning tool-using large language models (LLMs) under competing objectives. In the first stage, ParetoPO leverages hypervolume-guided dynamic scalarization to adapt reward weights based on global Pareto frontier progress. In the second stage, it replaces scalarized learning signals with Pareto-ranking-based advantage computation, promoting nondominated trajectories through dominance-aware credit assignment. This design enables fine-grained, action-level optimization across multiple conflicting objectives. Experimental results on mathematic reasoning and multi-hop QA tasks show that ParetoPO consistently discovers policies with superior accuracy-efficiency trade-offs compared to static and heuristic baselines.

</details>


### [321] [AuAu: A Benchmark for Auditing Authoritarian Alignment in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16127)
*Andreas Einwiller,Max Klabunde,Florian Lemmerich*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: AuAu是一个评估大语言模型威权倾向的综合基准，结合心理测量问卷、情境行为测试和真实用户提示三种方法。对来自中美俄欧的17个模型测试发现，所有模型在心理测量中均表现出显著威权响应率，但在更现实的任务中该比率显著下降。15/17的模型可通过威权系统提示轻易操纵以提升威权输出。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全球威权主义浪潮兴起，且LLM在用户日常生活中扮演日益核心的角色，引发了特定模型是否表现出或促进威权态度与特征的问题。现有研究缺乏对LLM威权倾向的系统评估基准。

Method: 构建AuAu基准，整合三种评估方法：(i)来自15个经过人类验证的心理测量工具的题目；(ii)情境行为小场景测试，探测在具体情境中的意图行动；(iii)对真实用户提示的响应。评估维度涵盖威权主义总体倾向及其三个子概念：威权攻击性、威权顺从性和传统主义。测试了来自中国、欧盟、俄罗斯和美国的17个模型。

Result: 所有测试模型在心理测量评估下均表现出显著的威权响应率；在更现实的下游任务中该比率显著下降。15/17的模型可通过威权系统提示轻易被操纵以增加威权主义输出。

Conclusion: 研究结果强调了对基于LLM的AI系统进行持续、系统性审计的必要性，以检测并最终减轻生成输出中不良的威权倾向。

Abstract: The worldwide surge of authoritarianism, combined with the increasing central role in users' everyday lives, raises the question of to what extent specific models exhibit or promote authoritarian attitudes and characteristics. We introduce AuAu, a comprehensive benchmark that aims to assess the risk of LLMs generating responses with authoritarian tendencies. This benchmark combines three evaluation approaches: (i) psychometric questions from an extensive pool of 15 human validated instruments; (ii) contextual behavior vignettes probing intended actions in concrete situations; and (iii) responses to realistic user prompts. Unlike prior work, AuAu evaluates not only a general closeness towards authoritarianism but also the established sub-concepts Authoritarian Aggression, Authoritarian Submission, and Conventionalism. Evaluating 17 models from China, the EU, Russia, and the USA, we find that all tested models exhibit substantial authoritarian response rates under the psychometric evaluation, though rates drop significantly in increasingly more realistic downstream task. We further find that an authoritarian system prompt easily manipulates 15 out of 17 models to promote increased authoritarianism. Our results underscore the need for continued, systematic auditing of LLM-based AI systems to detect and ultimately mitigate undesired authoritarian tendencies in generated output. Our code and data are available at: https://github.com/andreaseinwiller/AuAu

</details>


### [322] [XAI-Grounded Explanation Generation for Speech Deepfake Detection with Training-Free Multimodal Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16137)
*Yupei Li,Qiyang Sun,Xiaoliang Wu,Chenxi Wang,Berrak Sisman,Björn W. Schuller*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 针对语音深度伪造检测解释性不足的问题，提出一种无需训练的解释框架，将可解释AI证据与多模态大语言模型结合，生成有依据且具体的自然语言解释。在PartialSpoof数据集上，结合XAI的方法准确率提升超过45%，通过人工评估和忠实性检验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有语音深度伪造检测系统的解释方法存在两类缺陷：传统XAI（如梯度归因）产生低层级、难以被人类理解的归因信号；基于大语言模型的解释生成因缺乏启发式证据和任务特定监督，常产生通用且无依据的描述。究其根本，缺乏有依据的解释数据集是核心瓶颈。

Method: 提出无需训练的解释框架，核心思路是将传统XAI生成的低层级归因证据（如梯度信号）作为启发式线索，输入多模态大语言模型，驱动其生成有依据（grounded）且具体的自然语言解释。框架不依赖额外训练，利用PartialSpoof数据集构建了有依据的解释数据集作为评测基准。

Result: 在PartialSpoof数据集上，引入XAI证据的方法在内部准确率上提升超过45%。通过人工评估和忠实性检验（faithfulness checks）验证了方法的有效性。

Conclusion: 将XAI证据与多模态大语言模型结合是一种有效的、无需训练的语音深度伪造检测解释方案，能够生成有依据且易于理解的自然语言解释，显著提升解释准确性和可解释性。

Abstract: Speech deepfake detection (SDD) systems require trustworthy explanations for reliable decision-making. Existing explanation ways mainly fall into two categories. Traditional explainable AI (XAI), such as gradient-based attribution, produces low-level attribution signals tightly coupled with model decisions, and harder to be understood by human than natural language explanations. Meanwhile, large language model (LLM)-based explanation generation often produces generic and ungrounded descriptions due to the lack of heuristic evidence and task-specific supervision, stemming from limited grounded explanation datasets for SDD. We therefore propose a training-free explanation framework that integrates XAI evidence with multimodal LLMs to generate grounded and specific explanations. Using the PartialSpoof dataset, we construct a grounded explanation dataset and show that methods with XAI increase inside accuracy by over 45\%, verified through human evaluation and faithfulness checks.

</details>


### [323] [GRACE: Step-Level Benchmark for Faithful Reasoning over Context](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16151)
*Hoang Pham,Dong Le,Anh Tuan Luu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出GRACE，首个带人工标注的步骤级忠实度基准，用于上下文 grounded 文本推理。通过无监督聚类发现数据驱动的错误分类法（推理错误与接地错误各4类），实验表明当前模型存在显著提升空间，且将步骤级忠实度信号融入强化学习可同时提升下游准确率与推理可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有CoT方法虽然表面透明，但中间步骤可能悄然偏离源证据而最终答案正确；现有方法仅检测响应级幻觉，无法定位链中具体失败步骤及错误类型。

Method: 1) 构建GRACE基准：覆盖10个模型在4个源数据集上的CoT轨迹，每步标注忠实度、错误类别和自然语言解释；2) 通过无监督聚类自底向上发现数据驱动的错误分类法（GRACE-Inference和GRACE-Grounding两个分支各4类）；3) 将步骤级忠实度信号融入强化学习流程。

Result: 实验表明当前模型在GRACE上表现有显著提升空间（substantial headroom）；步骤级忠实度信号可提升下游准确率与推理可靠性。

Conclusion: 步骤级忠实度标注和细粒度错误分类对提升推理可靠性至关重要，并可作为训练信号改善模型性能。

Abstract: Many reasoning tasks require models to reason over input context, from document-grounded question answering to rule-based deduction. Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting produces traces that appear transparent, yet individual steps can silently deviate from the source evidence, even when the final answer is correct. Existing methods detect hallucinations at the response level but fail to identify where in the chain a failure occurs or what type it is. We introduce GRACE, the first human-annotated step-level faithfulness benchmark with a data-driven error taxonomy for context-grounded textual reasoning. GRACE covers CoT traces from 10 models across 4 source datasets, with each step annotated for faithfulness, error category, and natural language explanation. A data-driven taxonomy, discovered bottom-up via unsupervised clustering, organizes failures into two tracks: GRACE-Inference (deductive errors) and GRACE-Grounding (factual grounding errors), with four categories each. The evaluation set is human-annotated and challenging by design. Our experiments reveal substantial headroom for current models. In addition, integrating step-level faithfulness signals into reinforcement learning pipelines improves both downstream accuracy and reasoning reliability.

</details>


### [324] [Weaving Multi-Source Evidence for Biomedical Reasoning: The BioMedHop Benchmark and BioWeave Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16211)
*Xingyu Tan,Shiyuan Liu,Xiaoyang Wang,Qing Liu,Xiwei Xu,Xin Yuan,Liming Zhu,Wenjie Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出BioMedHop，一个多源图基生物医学推理基准（10,045个实例），涵盖KG、文献、网络及混合证据场景；同时提出BioWeave，一种源感知推理框架，通过构建统一证据图进行实体级验证。实验表明BioWeave在BioMedHop上最优，比强基线ToG-2平均高10.5%，且能提升小模型（如Qwen3-4B）至GPT-4-Turbo水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生物医学问答基准多聚焦于考试式知识、文献理解或短程多跳推理，缺乏对源条件图推理和证据拓扑构建的探索。

Method: 构建BioMedHop基准（10,045实例，含KG/文献/网络/混合四种证据设置及四种推理类型）；提出BioWeave框架，先检索KG路径，再收集文献与网络线索，组装为统一证据图，最后通过实体级证据支持进行答案验证。

Result: BioWeave在BioMedHop上整体平均性能最优，比强基线ToG-2高10.5%；持续提升不同LLM骨干性能，使Qwen3-4B达到GPT-4-Turbo水平。

Conclusion: 多源图基推理可有效提升生物医学问答的鲁棒性，且源感知证据图构建框架能显著缩小不同规模模型间的性能差距。

Abstract: Biomedical question answering (QA) increasingly requires reasoning over interacting entities, where supporting evidence is scattered across biomedical knowledge graphs, literature documents, and web-accessible resources. However, existing biomedical QA benchmarks mainly focus on exam-style knowledge, literature comprehension, or short-range multi-hop inference, leaving source-conditioned graph reasoning and evidence topology construction underexplored. To fill this gap, we introduce BioMedHop, a multi-source graph-grounded benchmark for evaluating biomedical reasoning over structured evidence topologies. BioMedHop contains 10,045 instances across KG, document, web, and hybrid evidence settings, covering shared-neighbor matching, intersection reasoning, path-based reasoning, and counting, with option-based, open-ended, and numeric count renderings. To support this benchmark, we further propose BioWeave, a source-aware reasoning framework that retrieves biomedical KG paths, gathers supporting clues from documents and web sources, assembles them into a unified evidence graph, and verifies answers through entity-level evidence support. Comprehensive experiments show that BioWeave achieves the best overall performance among compared methods on BioMedHop, outperforming the strong hybrid baseline ToG-2 by 10.5% in the overall average. Moreover, BioWeave consistently improves different LLM backbones and enables smaller models, such as Qwen3-4B, to achieve reasoning performance comparable to GPT-4-Turbo.

</details>


### [325] [PACT: Privileged Trace Co-Training for Multi-Turn Tool-Use Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16215)
*Zhenbang Du,Jun Luo,Zhiwei Zheng,Xiangchi Yuan,Kejing Xia,Dachuan Shi,Qirui Jin,Qijia He,Shaofeng Zou,Yingbin Liang,Wenke Lee*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出PACT框架，利用专家轨迹作为训练时的特权信号（而非推理时提示），通过轨迹条件RL和组件感知SFT两种互补目标来优化多轮工具使用智能体，在FTRL、BFCL和ToolHop上优于SFT和RL基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多轮工具使用智能体的后训练面临两难：RL因稀疏奖励和弱信用分配难以训练，而SFT在专家轨迹上提供密集过程监督但过度约束模型到固定轨迹。需要一种既能利用专家轨迹的密集监督又不过度限制模型探索的方法。

Method: PACT框架包含三个关键组件：1) 轨迹条件RL代理，在专家轨迹上下文中评估纯提示rollout；2) 组件感知SFT损失，以退火强度监督推理前缀和工具调用；3) 纯提示锚定，减少对训练时轨迹上下文的过度依赖。推理时仅使用纯提示生成rollout，专家轨迹仅在训练时作为优化信号。

Result: 在FTRL、BFCL和ToolHop三个基准上的实验表明，PACT一致优于强SFT和RL基线，验证了特权轨迹协同训练对多轮工具使用学习的价值。

Conclusion: PACT通过将专家轨迹作为训练时特权信号而非推理时提示，有效结合了RL的探索能力和SFT的密集监督优势，为多轮工具智能体后训练提供了新范式。

Abstract: Multi-turn tool-use agents must reason, call tools, and adapt to observations across several interaction turns. Post-training such agents is challenging, as reinforcement learning often suffers from sparse rewards and weak credit assignment despite matching the prompt-only inference setting, while supervised fine-tuning on expert traces provides dense process supervision but can over-constrain the model to fixed trajectories. To tackle this, we propose PACT, a Privileged trAce Co-Training framework for multi-turn tool-use agents. The key idea is to use expert traces only as training-time optimization signals rather than rollout-time hints. PACT keeps rollout generation prompt-only, then uses expert traces to guide optimization through two complementary signals: a trace-conditioned RL surrogate that evaluates prompt-only rollouts under expert-trace context, and a component-aware SFT loss that supervises reasoning prefixes and tool-calls with annealed strength. To reduce over-reliance on the training-only trace context, PACT further introduces a prompt-only anchoring. We also provide a latent-trace view that connects the two trace-based objectives and explains how expert traces can guide optimization without being used during rollout generation. Experiments on FTRL, BFCL, and ToolHop show that PACT consistently improves over strong SFT- and RL-based baselines, highlighting the value of privileged trace co-training for multi-turn tool-use learning.

</details>


### [326] [Creative Collision: Directorial Persona Steering and Competition in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16240)
*Subramanyam Sahoo,Justin Shenk*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究在Transformer残差流中叠加两个语义对立的方向向量（斯皮尔伯格的乐观救赎 vs 斯科塞斯的黑暗模糊），发现斯皮尔伯格向量具有方向主导性，中间碰撞点反提高生成连贯性，且两种人格向量均在第28层最大化定位，揭示共享的道德基调基底。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有激活引导方法多注入单一语义方向，但缺乏对多个对立语义向量叠加时的相互作用几何的研究，无法实现更细粒度的可控创造性生成。

Method: 通过均值差异激活对比在剧本语料上构建斯皮尔伯格和斯科塞斯的导演人格向量，用标量混合参数α∈[0,1]和引导系数λ进行插值，在五个评估轴上分析向量交互。

Result: (i) 斯皮尔伯格向量表现出稳健的方向主导性，几乎在整个插值范围内压制斯科塞斯的道德影响；(ii) 中间碰撞点在强引导下反而提高生成连贯性；(iii) 两种人格向量均在40层解码器的第28层最大化激活，共享道德基调神经基底。

Conclusion: 揭示了Transformer残差流中竞争语义方向的几何特性，为可控创造性生成和价值对齐叙事合成提供了直接启示。

Abstract: Activation steering has emerged as a powerful tool for shaping the behaviour of large language models at inference time, yet most prior work injects a \emph{single} semantic direction into the residual stream. We study the richer setting in which two semantically opposing steering vectors are superimposed -- a regime we call \textbf{Creative Collision}. Concretely, we construct directorial persona vectors for Steven Spielberg (optimistic, redemptive moral valence) and Martin Scorsese (dark, morally ambiguous) via mean-difference activation contrast on curated screenplay-derived corpora, then interpolate between them with a scalar mixing parameter $α\in [0,1]$ and a steering coefficient $λ$. Across five evaluation axes -- moral valence, generation coherence, surface style, directional dominance, and vector geometry -- three principal findings emerge: (i)~Spielberg's representational signature exhibits robust \emph{directional dominance}, suppressing Scorsese's moral influence across almost the entire interpolation range; (ii)~intermediate collision points paradoxically \emph{improve} generation coherence relative to pure single-director steering at high $λ$; and (iii)~both personas localise maximally to layer~28 of a 40-layer decoder-only transformer, revealing a shared \emph{moral-tone substrate}. These results illuminate the geometry of competing semantic directions in transformer residual streams and have direct implications for controllable creative generation and value-aligned narrative synthesis.

</details>


### [327] [Who Should Lead Decoding Now? Tracking Reliable Trajectories for Ensembling Masked Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16281)
*Heecheol Yun,Joonhyung Park,Joowon Kim,Eunho Yang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出TIE框架，通过跟踪MDLM在生成过程中答案相关位置的置信度动态，识别可靠的解码轨迹并在模型间传递部分去噪序列，实现知识融合，提升推理任务性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着掩码扩散语言模型在能力和知识覆盖度上日益多样化，如何有效融合多个MDLM的知识成为一个重要但未充分探索的问题。

Method: 提出TIE（Trajectory-based Iterative Ensembling）框架，通过跟踪答案相关位置上的置信度动态来判断哪个模型当前遵循更可靠的轨迹，并选择性地将部分去噪序列在不同模型间传递。

Result: 在多种推理任务上表现优异，验证了TIE框架的有效性。

Conclusion: TIE为MDLM集成这一未被充分探索的问题提供了一种实用方法，允许不同模型在生成的不同阶段贡献互补优势。

Abstract: Masked Diffusion Language Models (MDLMs) have emerged as a distinct paradigm for sequence generation. As MDLMs become diverse in capabilities and knowledge coverage, an important question is how to combine their knowledge. Toward this, we first investigate the unique decoding dynamics of MDLMs. We find that successful generations exhibit stable confidence dynamics over answer-relevant positions, while unreliable trajectories can often be corrected by injecting promising intermediate states from other models. Guided by this observation, we propose $\textbf{TIE}$ ($\textbf{T}$rajectory-based $\textbf{I}$terative $\textbf{E}$nsembling), a knowledge fusion framework in which MDLMs iteratively identify reliable decoding trajectories and relay them across models. TIE tracks confidence dynamics over answer-relevant positions to determine which model currently follows a more reliable trajectory and selectively transfers partially denoised sequences across models. As the model on the more promising trajectory often changes across denoising steps, TIE allows different models to contribute complementary strengths at different stages of generation. Strong performance across diverse reasoning tasks, along with our analyses, suggests that TIE offers a practical approach to the underexplored problem of MDLM ensembling.

</details>


### [328] [HiMPO: Hindsight-Informed Memory Policy Optimization for Less-Entangled Credit in Long-Horizon Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16285)
*Jiangze Yan,Yi Shen,Wenjing Zhang,Jieyun Huang,Zhaoxiang Liu,Ning Wang,Kai Wang,Shiguo Lian*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: HiMPO是一种基于事后回想的记忆策略优化框架，通过解耦记忆更新的因果信用，提升长时程智能体的记忆质量和任务表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时程智能体的记忆写入面临信用分配难题：记忆更新的回报可能因下游工具故障、噪声观测或推理错误而被错误奖励或惩罚，导致智能体丢弃有用证据或保留无关信息。

Method: HiMPO首先通过比较更新前后记忆在相同预写状态下可恢复的任务相关信息，估计记忆更新的局部效用；然后利用事后相关性作为有界追溯滤波器，在局部效用未得到目标结果支持时衰减记忆信用；最后将生成的记忆特定优势仅应用于记忆token，而轨迹级奖励优化智能体其余行为。

Result: 在基于评判的开放域任务和客观压缩记忆问答任务上，HiMPO优于强记忆基线和基于RL的基线，同时保持压缩上下文效率。控制干预实验表明，HiMPO减少了工具诱导错误的归因泄漏，提高了记忆更新的归因忠实度。

Conclusion: HiMPO通过解耦记忆更新的因果信用有效提升了长时程智能体的记忆质量和任务性能，验证了局部效用估计与事后回溯滤波相结合的策略有效性。

Abstract: Long-horizon agents rely on memory mechanisms to compress interaction history, but optimizing memory writing faces a distinct credit assignment challenge: a memory update may be rewarded or penalized due to downstream tool failures, noisy observations, or reasoning errors rather than its own contribution. This causally entangled credit can lead agents to discard useful evidence or preserve irrelevant information. We propose HiMPO, a Hindsight-Informed Memory Policy Optimization framework for assigning less-entangled credit to memory-writing actions in long-horizon agents. HiMPO first estimates the local utility of a memory update by comparing the task-relevant information recoverable from the previous and updated memories under the same pre-write state. It then uses hindsight relevance as a bounded retrospective filter that attenuates memory credit when local utility is not supported by the target outcome. The resulting memory-specific advantage is applied only to memory tokens, while trajectory-level rewards optimize the rest of the agent behavior. Across judge-based open-domain tasks and objective compressive-memory QA, HiMPO improves over strong memory-based and RL-based baselines while preserving compressed-context efficiency. Controlled interventions further show that HiMPO reduces blame leakage from tool-induced errors and improves attribution fidelity of memory updates.

</details>


### [329] [PaperJury: Due-Process Review for Bounded LaTeX Revision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16322)
*Yiran Wang,Ruixuan An,Biao Wu,Wenhao Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: PaperJury 是一个面向论文投稿前硬化的闭环审稿-判决-修改-验证系统，通过确定性编排与语义代理的分离架构，实现可终止的、边界安全的论文修订流程，支持无效驳回、有效可修复和需作者处理三种终局。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有写作辅助工具、批评生成器和以裁判为中心的循环机制缺乏跨轮次持久的问题标识、从评审到裁决的确定性路由，以及能拒绝无效关切或推迟依赖作者修改的稿件控制能力。

Method: 采用确定性编排与语义代理分离的架构：确定性编排负责分解、冻结声明主干、持久化账本、路由、停止和精确一次补丁应用；语义代理限于边界内的评审、判决和修复。结合边界整体评审、基于可争议性的路由、正当程序审判和风险比例守卫链，确保锚定边界编辑。

Result: 在 Vision、NLP 和机器学习论文上，与四个基线进行双组专家评审评估，从问题质量、判决与路由质量、编辑安全性、收敛行为和成本五个维度验证了承载安全与完成逻辑应位于确定性编排而非模型自由裁量权这一论点。

Conclusion: 负载安全与完成逻辑应位于确定性编排而非模型自由裁量权中，PaperJury 通过分离架构有效实现了投稿前硬化的闭环审稿修订流程。

Abstract: Pre-submission hardening of human-authored LaTeX computer science papers differs from drafting assistance because it requires adversarial whole-paper review, explicit no-fix outcomes, and bounded artifact-safe revision. Existing writing assistants, critique generators, and judge-centered loops lack durable issue identity across rounds, deterministic routing from critique to adjudication, and manuscript control that can reject invalid concerns or defer author-dependent ones. We present PaperJury, a closed-loop review-verdict-revise-verify system built on a deterministic-versus-semantic split: deterministic orchestration manages decomposition, a frozen claim spine, a durable ledger, routing, stopping, and exact-once patch application, while semantic agents are limited to bounded review, judgment, and repair. PaperJury combines bounded holistic review, contestability-based routing, a due-process trial, and risk-proportional guard chains for anchor-bounded edits, yielding terminal outcomes of invalid-drop, valid-fixable, and author-required. In a two-arm expert-review evaluation on held-out Vision, natural language processing, and machine learning papers against four baselines, we assess issue quality, verdict and routing quality, edit safety, convergence behavior, and cost, supporting the thesis that load-bearing safety and completion logic should reside in deterministic orchestration rather than model discretion. PaperJury is available at https://github.com/u7079256/paperjury.

</details>


### [330] [TMASC: Transmasculine Attitude and Speech Corpus](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16351)
*Sidney Wong*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文介绍了跨男性态度与语音语料库（TMASC），包含196名跨性别男性的问卷数据及66份音频录音，并展示了该语料库在感知-声学数据整合、群体特征识别和声学测量校准三方面的应用案例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨男性群体在语音健康和声学特征方面缺乏专门的多模态语料库支撑研究，现有数据不足以系统理解其声学特征与健康需求。

Method: 通过众包方式收集196名跨男性个体的问卷数据（涵盖嗓音健康）及66份音频录音（含咳嗽、清嗓、朗读段落及会话问题），构建多模态语料库并设计三项案例研究验证其可用性。

Result: 成功构建包含问卷与声学数据的多模态语料库；三项案例分别实现了感知与声学数据的融合、跨男性群体声学特征的群体层面识别，以及声学测量方法的校准。

Conclusion: TMASC语料库可作为支持跨男性群体嗓音研究与临床实践的有效工具，尤其适用于整合多模态数据以优化声学分析和健康干预。

Abstract: We introduce the Transmasculine Attitudes and Speech Corpus (TMASC), a multimodal corpus of 196 transmasculine individuals, including questionnaire responses and 66 audio recordings. The questionnaire includes items exploring the vocal health of transmasculine individuals. The audio recordings include cough and throat-clearing samples, a reading passage, and additional session-specific questions. This paper outlines the development of this corpus and the data collection procedures. To illustrate the utility of this corpus, we present three case studies demonstrating how this crowd-sourced multimodal corpus can be used to support transmasculine individuals. These include the integration of perceptual and acoustic data, the identification of group-level characteristics, and the calibration of acoustic measurements.

</details>


### [331] [Tyler: Typed Latent Reasoning for Language Models -- When to Think, What to Compute, and How Much to Allocate](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16360)
*Hanyu Lin,Min Cai,Jiawei Wen,Haodi Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出Tyler框架，通过学习一个策略在自回归解码中动态选择文本生成或三种类型的潜在计算（全局规划、局部状态更新、可复用过程抽象），在多个大模型上提升推理准确率最高达14.49点，并减少遗忘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有CoT方法通过离散文本进行中间推理带来冗余和推理开销；潜在推理虽可缓解但现有方法预先定义了何时调用潜在计算及其分配方式，未解决何时调用、执行何种计算以及分配多少预算的关键问题。

Method: 提出Tyler框架，学习一个策略在每步解码中选择生成文本token或切换到三种专门的潜在计算模块之一（全局规划、局部状态更新、可复用过程抽象），并动态分配计算预算。

Result: 在三个骨干LLM上，Tyler相比CoT准确率提升最高14.49点，相比最强基线提升最高4.30点；在多种推理领域上泛化良好，实现最佳最终阶段性能且遗忘最低。

Conclusion: Tyler通过类型化且预算感知的潜在推理框架有效解决了何时、何种类型以及多少预算进行潜在计算的问题，在多个推理任务上取得显著提升。

Abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting improves reasoning in large language models (LLMs) by externalizing intermediate computation as discrete text tokens, but this textual interface also introduces redundancy and inference overhead. Latent reasoning offers a promising alternative by carrying part of the computation in continuous representations. However, existing methods typically predefine when latent computation is invoked and how it is allocated during decoding, leaving a key problem unresolved: when to invoke latent computation, what type of computation to perform, and how much budget to allocate. We propose \textbf{Ty}ped \textbf{L}at\textbf{e}nt \textbf{R}easoning (Tyler), a typed and budget-aware framework for latent reasoning during autoregressive decoding. Tyler learns a policy that, at each decoding step, chooses between emitting a text token and switching to a latent computation module specialized for a particular reasoning function. Once invoked, an operator maps the current reasoning state into latent tokens that support global planning, local state updates, or reusable procedural abstraction. Across extensive experiments on three backbone LLMs, Tyler improves accuracy by up to 14.49 points over CoT and by up to 4.30 points over the strongest competing baseline. It further generalizes across diverse reasoning domains and achieves the best final-stage performance with the lowest forgetting.

</details>


### [332] [Evaluating LLM Personalization via Semantic Constraint Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16368)
*Xuran Li,Guanqin Zhang,Imran Razzak,Hakim Hacid,Eleanna Kafeza,Hao Xue,Flora D. Salim*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出NLICV框架，利用自然语言推理模型将句子映射为真值条件集，以实现可解释、可扩展的LLM个性化约束验证，相比LLM裁判方法速度提升2100倍，并支持细粒度行为分类与可追溯性证据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM个性化评估方法依赖脆弱的表面匹配指标或计算昂贵的LLM裁判协议，缺乏可解释性，亟需一种可扩展且语义不变的评估框架。

Method: 通过将句子含义映射为真值条件集，利用NLI模型验证个性化约束；将LLM行为划分为个性化、泛化、谄媚和失败四种模式；采用消融过程定位驱动约束验证的关键句子。

Result: 与人类标注高度一致；相比LLM裁判，推理速度提升高达2100倍，显著降低延迟和令牌成本；可精确定位影响约束验证的关键句子。

Conclusion: NLICV是一种可解释、高效且与人类判断高度对齐的LLM个性化评估框架，克服了现有方法的局限性。

Abstract: Current evaluation paradigms for Large Language Model (LLM) personalization rely heavily on brittle surface-matching metrics or computationally expensive LLM-as-a-judge protocols, both of which lack interpretability. To address these limitations, we introduce Natural Language Inference Constraint Verification (NLICV), a scalable, semantically invariant framework that maps sentence meanings to truth-condition sets to verify personalization constraints via a Natural Language Inference (NLI) model. Moving beyond binary scoring, NLICV categorizes LLM behaviors into four distinct modes: personalization, generalization, sycophancy, and failure. Extensive experiments demonstrate that NLICV aligns closely with human annotations while drastically reducing the latency and token costs associated with LLM judges (up to 2100 inference speedup). Finally, through an ablation-based procedure, NLICV pinpoints the exact sentences driving the constraint verification, yielding faithful, understandable evidence for its evaluations.

</details>


### [333] [Surpassing Scale by Efficiency: A Compact 135M Parameter Foundational LLM Natively Adapted for the Bangla Language](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16383)
*Rabindra Nath Nandi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 bangla-smollm-135m，一个仅1.35亿参数的紧凑型解码器基础模型，专为孟加拉语的高效语言建模设计。通过确定性交并分词合并策略解决子词碎片化问题，在零样本多任务评估中匹配或超越两倍大小模型（Gemma-3-270m），并与10亿参数级模型性能持平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前NLP领域被数十亿参数的大模型主导，但这些模型在低资源、非拉丁语系场景下，因计算成本过高而难以部署在边缘设备、移动系统和去中心化本地硬件上，存在计算可行性与语言覆盖的鸿沟。

Method: 采用确定性交并（intersect-and-append）分词合并策略，融合TituLLMs与SmolLM2-135M的分词器，在保持预训练参数状态稳定的前提下，克服孟加拉语子词脚本碎片化问题，构建135M参数的decoder-only基础模型。

Result: 在PIQA_bn、OpenBookQA_bn、CommonsenseQA_bn和Bangla_MMLU四项零样本多任务基准评估中，bangla-smollm-135m匹配或超越两倍参数量的Gemma-3-270m，并与10亿参数级模型达到同等性能水平。

Conclusion: 证明了紧凑型模型通过针对性的分词优化策略，可以在低资源非拉丁语系场景中达到与大规模模型相当的性能，为边缘部署提供了可行的轻量化方案。模型已在rnnandi/bangla-smollm-135m开源。

Abstract: While the NLP landscape is dominated by multi-billion parameter architectures, their deployment in low-resource, non-Latin scripts remains computationally prohibitive for edge configurations, mobile systems, and decentralized local hardware. This paper presents bangla-smollm-135m, a highly compact 135-million parameter decoder-only foundational model engineered explicitly for high-efficiency language modeling in the Bangla script. By leveraging a deterministic intersect-and-append token merging strategy between TituLLMs and SmolLM2-135M, the model overcomes subword script fragmentation without destabilizing early pretrained parameter states. In zero-shot multi-task benchmark evaluations (PIQA_bn, OpenBookQA_bn, CommonsenseQA_bn, and Bangla_MMLU), bangla-smollm-135m matches or outperforms models twice its size (Gemma-3-270m) and achieves parity with models in the 1B parameter tier. The model is available at rnnandi/bangla-smollm-135m

</details>


### [334] [A Mechanistic Understanding of Pronoun Fidelity in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16407)
*Katharina Trinley,Jesujoba O. Alabi,Dietrich Klakow,Vagrant Gautam*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文通过机械可解释性方法，发现代词忠实性源于三种因果子空间（群体绑定、近期性偏差、刻板偏见）的竞争，而非单一机制。注意头分析揭示了两种不同的复制路径：概念级（群体绑定与刻板偏见共享）和词元级（近期性偏差）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有代词消解研究仅依赖行为方法（behavioral approaches），无法反映模型内部工作机制。作者希望从机械（mechanistic）视角，探究大语言模型中代词忠实性背后的因果机制。

Method: 使用Boundless Distributed Alignment Search（BDAS）方法，在多个SOTA语言模型中测试三种机制（群体实体绑定G、近期性偏差R、刻板偏见S）是否存在因果实现，并进一步进行注意力头分析。

Result: 三种机制共存的因果子空间分布于网络各层；单一机制无法完全解释模型行为，三者组合可解释91-99.5%的方差；注意头分析发现两种竞争性复制路径：群体绑定与刻板偏见共享一条基于概念的局部路径（检索绑定的职业-代词单元），近期性偏差使用一条基于词元的分布式路径（重复表面形式）。

Conclusion: 代词忠实性源于同时活跃的因果子空间之间的竞争，模型行为是多种机制动态博弈的结果。

Abstract: Faithful and robust pronoun use is important for fair and coherent generations, yet large language models largely fail when multiple referents use different pronouns. To study the interplay of reasoning, repetition, and bias in this task, prior work relies exclusively on behavioural approaches, which may not reflect a model's internal workings. Therefore, we provide a mechanistic, model-internal perspective on pronoun fidelity, testing whether three mechanisms -- group entity binding (G), recency bias (R), and stereotypical bias (S) -- are causally implemented across several SOTA language models. Using Boundless Distributed Alignment Search, we find all three coexist as causal subspaces distributed across network depth. No single mechanism fully explains model behaviour, but a combination of the three consistently accounts for 91-99.5%. An attention head analysis further reveals two competing copying routes; group binding and stereotype share a localized concept-level route that retrieves a bound occupation-pronoun unit, while recency uses a distributed token-level route that repeats surface forms. In sum, pronoun fidelity arises from competition between simultaneously active causal subspaces.

</details>


### [335] [PathRouter: Aligning Rewards with Retrieval Quality in Agentic Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16409)
*Bo Wang,Heyan Huang,Yaolin Li,Wei Tang,Yuan Zhang,Wenbo Li,Mingze Gao,Ge Shi,Chong Feng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: PathRouter提出一种路径感知的训练框架，通过联合评估答案正确性和证据路径重叠度来缓解Agentic GraphRAG中的答案-路径奖励混淆和搜索-更新歧义问题，在6个QA基准上显著提升了F1分数和证据路径重叠度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Agentic GraphRAG中，基于结果（outcome-only）的强化学习存在两个关键问题：(1) 答案-路径奖励混淆：正确答案可能来自捷径而非有用的证据路径；(2) 搜索-更新歧义：标量的轨迹级反馈无法指示应调整哪些检索动作。亟需一种能够同时评估答案和检索路径质量的训练框架。

Method: PathRouter框架包含两个核心机制：(1) 四类轨迹划分与差异化GRPO优势缩放：根据答案正确性和证据路径重叠度将轨迹分为四类，对不同类别施加差异化的优势缩放，抑制捷径强化同时保留证据探索行为；(2) 冻结的金证据教师提供token级KL引导：对证据不足的轨迹，在推理和搜索查询token上（排除答案token）提供KL散度监督，避免直接模仿答案。

Result: 在6个QA基准上、3种模型规模下实验，PathRouter一致提升了答案F1和证据路径重叠度。相比强基线，在3B模型上平均F1提升3.1，在7B模型上平均F1提升4.9。

Conclusion: PathRouter通过路径感知的奖励设计和token级KL引导，有效解决了Agentic GraphRAG中结果驱动强化学习的两个根本性问题，实现了更准确的决策和更高质量的检索路径。

Abstract: Agentic GraphRAG trains language-model agents to iteratively retrieve and reason over graph-structured evidence, enabling more accurate and context-aware decision-making by efficiently navigating complex information networks. However, outcome-only reinforcement learning suffers from \textit{\textbf{answer-path reward aliasing}}, where correct answers may come from shortcuts rather than useful evidence paths. It also exhibits \textit{\textbf{search-update ambiguity}}, as scalar trajectory-level feedback does not indicate which retrieval actions to adjust. To mitigate these shortcomings, we present PathRouter, a path-aware training framework for agentic GraphRAG. PathRouter jointly evaluates each trajectory along answer correctness and evidence-path overlap, yielding four trajectory categories with differentiated GRPO advantage scaling that suppresses shortcut reinforcement while preserving evidence-seeking behavior. For evidence-poor trajectories, a frozen gold-evidence teacher provides token-level KL guidance on reasoning and search-query tokens, excluding answer tokens to avoid direct response imitation. Experiments on six QA benchmarks across three model sizes show that PathRouter consistently improves answer F1 and evidence-path overlap, achieving average F1 gains of 3.1 on 3B and 4.9 on 7B models compared to a strong baseline.

</details>


### [336] [LectūraAgents: A Multi-Agent Framework for Adaptive Personalized AI-Assisted Learning and Embodied Teaching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16428)
*Jaward Sesay,Yue Yu,Siwei Dong,Yemin Shi,Guangyao Chen,Börje F. Karlsson*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出了LectūraAgents——一个多智能体框架，通过分层架构和自适应具身教学机制实现端到端的个性化学习，在高中、本科和研究生课程中优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有教育智能体主要侧重于讲座内容自动化和模拟，缺乏针对个体学习者的多模态和具身化教学方法建模，无法动态适应多样化学习者的需求。

Method: 提出LectūraAgents框架：(1) 分层多智能体架构模拟教授-学生关系，由ProfessorAgent领导协作团队完成研究、规划、审查和具身授课；(2) 自适应具身教学机制，ProfessorAgent执行可见的教学动作（手写、高亮、下划线等）；(3) Teaching Action-Speech Alignment (TASA)算法，基于显著性启发式和时序语义分割生成连贯教学动作序列。

Result: 在高中、本科和研究生多级别课程上，使用基于评分细则的分析和专家教育者评估，在讲座内容质量、具身教学质量、评估和个性化方面均优于现有方法。

Conclusion: LectūraAgents是一个教学法上基础扎实的个性化学习框架，能够实现规模化个性化教学。

Abstract: Effective personalized AI-assisted learning demands systems that can not only generate accurate learner-specific educational materials, but also dynamically adapt their instruction to diverse learners. However, existing educational agents have primarily focused on lecture content automation and simulations, which often fall short of modelling multimodal and embodied instructional methods tailored for the individual learner. To this end, we propose LectūraAgents - a multi-agent framework that enables personalized learning through end-to-end adaptive embodied teaching. At its core, LectūraAgents mirrors a professor-student relationship, in which a ProfessorAgent leads a collaborative team of specialized subordinate agents through research, planning, review, and embodied delivery of lecture contents that adapt to a learner's needs. The framework offers three main contributions: (1) a hierarchical multi-agent architecture for end-to-end personalized learning; (2) an adaptive embodied teaching mechanism, wherein the ProfessorAgent executes visible and pedagogically motivated teaching actions (e.g., handwrite, highlight, underline, etc.) over contents in a teaching environment; and (3) a Teaching Action-Speech Alignment (TASA) algorithm that employs salience-based heuristics and temporal semantic segmentation to generate coherent teaching action sequences aligned with learner profiles. We evaluate LectūraAgents on diverse courses at high school, undergraduate, and graduate levels using sample-specific rubric-based analysis; with generated lecture materials and teaching actions assessed and validated by expert educators. Experimental results show consistent gains in lecture content quality, embodied teaching quality, assessment, and personalization over existing approaches, positioning LectūraAgents as a pedagogically well-grounded framework for personalized learning at scale.

</details>


### [337] [ACCORD: Action-Conditioned Contextual Grounding for Language Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16432)
*Lai Jiang,Cheng Qian,Zhenhailong Wang,Pan Lu,Heng Ji,Hao Peng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出ACCORD框架，通过在执行每个动作前主动探查环境缺失信息并整合轨迹中相关上下文，显著提升LLM代理在信息丰富环境中的任务完成度，在AppWorld基准上最高提升+20.6个点，无需额外训练或任务成功信号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 用户指令常因隐含的环境假设而欠指定，LLM代理需要在信息丰富的数字/物理环境中恢复这些假设，但现有代理常因依赖假设而非观察到的信息、忽略可收集的信息、未能整合已返回的证据而失败。

Method: ACCORD是一种基于动作条件上下文接地（Action-Conditioned Contextual Grounding）的代理框架，在每个动作执行前主动探查环境以获取缺失信息，并整合代理轨迹中本可能被忽略的相关上下文，无需额外训练或任务成功信号。

Result: 在AppWorld上，GPT-5-mini从42.0%提升至62.6%（+20.6）；Claude-4.5-sonnet提升+10.8；Qwen3.5-27B-FP8提升+10.1；在AlfWorld仿真基准上GPT-5-mini成功率提升+7.4。

Conclusion: ACCORD是一种简单有效的自适应接地框架，能显著提升LLM代理在信息丰富环境中的任务完成度，且对多种模型和基准均表现出一致增益。

Abstract: User instructions are often underspecified because humans rely on implicit assumptions about the surrounding environment. For large language model (LLM) agents operating in information-rich digital and physical environments, these assumptions cannot be inferred from the instruction alone; they must be recovered from the current state of tools, data, interfaces, and observations. Effective execution therefore requires agents to identify missing context, ground it in observed evidence, and carry it forward into subsequent actions. We show that current agents often fail to do so. They act from assumed rather than observed specifics, overlook information they could have gathered, and fail to incorporate evidence that has already been returned. Building on this insight, we propose ACCORD (Action-Conditioned Contextual Grounding), a simple and effective agent framework for adaptive grounding. Before each action, ACCORD actively probes the environment for missing information and integrates relevant context from the agent's trajectory that would otherwise be overlooked. Requiring no additional training or task-success signals, ACCORD improves task-goal completion on AppWorld by up to +20.6 points with GPT-5-mini, from 42.0% to 62.6%, compared to strong baselines. These gains persist with a substantially stronger base model (+10.8 with Claude-4.5-sonnet), an open-weight model (+10.1 with Qwen3.5-27B-FP8), and on the embodied AlfWorld benchmark (+7.4 success rate with GPT-5-mini).

</details>


### [338] [From Awareness to Adherence: Bridging the Context Gap in Spoken Dialogue Systems via Context-Aware Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16472)
*Che Hyun Lee,Heeseung Kim,Sungroh Yoon*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出音频适应的上下文感知解码（CAD）方法，通过对比有无关键历史上下文的输出分布，放大多模态上下文信号，弥合对话系统中潜在上下文感知与主动遵循之间的差距，在Audio MultiChallenge基准上显著提升语义记忆和自一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 端到端口语对话系统在多轮对话中存在严格上下文遵循的挑战，以往归因于模型遗忘对话历史，但本文发现一个被忽视的瓶颈：模型内部隐式感知到相关历史话语，但强大的参数先验在解码时常覆盖这些信号，导致潜在上下文感知与主动遵循之间存在差距。

Method: 提出音频适应的上下文感知解码（CAD）方法。利用内部注意力机制隔离关键历史轮次，在推理时对比有无该关键上下文的输出分布，直接放大多模态上下文信号。

Result: 在Audio MultiChallenge基准上，语义记忆和自一致性子任务取得显著提升，成功实现了严格、忠实的上下文遵循。

Conclusion: 揭示了对话系统中潜在上下文感知与主动遵循之间的关键差距，并通过CAD方法有效弥合了这一差距，为提升多轮口语对话的上下文忠实性提供了新途径。

Abstract: Despite the success of end-to-end (E2E) spoken dialogue systems, maintaining strict context adherence in multi-round conversations remains a challenge. While prior works attribute these failures to models forgetting dialogue history, we highlight an equally critical but overlooked bottleneck: a gap between latent context awareness and active adherence. Although models internally recognize relevant past utterances, strong parametric priors often overshadow these signals during decoding. To bridge this gap, we propose an audio-adapted Context-Aware Decoding (CAD) approach. By leveraging internal attention mechanisms to isolate key historical rounds, our approach contrasts output distributions with and without this key context during inference, directly amplifying multimodal contextual signals. Evaluations on the Audio MultiChallenge benchmark demonstrate significant improvements in Semantic Memory and Self Coherence subtasks, successfully enforcing strict, context-faithful adherence.

</details>


### [339] [Lost at the End: Primacy Bias in Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16494)
*Jieyuan Liu,Jianyang Gu,Shijie Chen,Jefferson Chen,Zhen Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文首次系统研究了多模态知识型视觉问答（KB-VQA）中检索增强阅读器的位置偏差问题。通过设计“黄金位置”实验协议，发现不同于纯文本中的U型“lost-in-the-middle”效应，多模态KB-VQA表现为“首部优先”（primacy）效应，即首个位置准确率比末尾位置高16-26个百分点，称之为“Lost at the End”。消融实验表明，多模态设置将已存在的文本首部效应放大2.2-4.5倍，根源在于指令微调阅读器的第0个提示槽。检索端修复（MMR、重排序、重排位）均无法消除该差距，需阅读器端干预。作者指出recall@k是KB-VQA部署的误导性指标，并开源了评估协议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 纯文本长上下文LLM存在检索位置依赖的“lost-in-the-middle”U型效应，但该现象是否在部署的多模态KB-VQA系统中成立尚不清楚。填补这一空白，为多模态系统优化提供依据。

Method: 设计“黄金位置”实验协议：固定仅黄金段落改变其在检索上下文中的提示槽位置；在3个7B/8B开源VLM阅读器和2个KB-VQA基准上测试k≤20；进行文本对照、图像位置、干扰项打乱三项消融实验；评估检索端修复（MMR、oracle重排序、基于排名的重新排序）的效果。

Result: 位置依赖性从U型翻转为首部优先效应：黄金段落位于首位比末尾准确率高16-26个百分点；多模态放大了2.2-4.5倍的文本首部效应；根源锁定在指令微调阅读器的第0个提示槽；所有检索端修复均无法消除该差距。

Conclusion: recall@k是KB-VQA部署中错误的核心指标；缩小位置差距需要阅读器端而非检索端干预；本文开放了评估协议作为标准测试工具。

Abstract: Knowledge-based visual question answering (KB-VQA) lets vision-language systems answer questions that exceed their parametric knowledge by conditioning a reader on passages retrieved from a Wikipedia-scale knowledge base. In pure-text long-context LLMs, retrieved-context use follows the U-shaped "lost-in-the-middle" effect of Liu et al. (2024): information at the start and end of context is used, the middle is lost. Whether this transfers to deployed multimodal KB-VQA is open. To close this gap, we design the first controlled probe of reader-side position dependence in multimodal KB-VQA: a gold-position protocol in which only the gold passage's prompt slot varies within question. We run it on three open-source 7B/8B VLM readers and two KB-VQA benchmarks at k up to 20. The shape flips from U to primacy: gold-at-first beats gold-at-last by 16 to 26 points on every reader-by-benchmark cell, an effect we call "Lost at the End". Three targeted ablations narrow the cause: a text-only control shows the multimodal setting amplifies an already-present text-mode primacy 2.2 to 4.5 times, and image-position and distractor-shuffle ablations together pin the locus to prompt slot 0 of the instruction-tuned reader. On a frozen reader, three retrieval-side fixes (MMR, oracle reranking, rank-based reordering) all leave the gap intact (no separable improvement). Our findings indicate that recall@k is the wrong metric for deployed KB-VQA and that closing the gap requires reader-side intervention; we release our protocol as a controlled instrument for evaluating such interventions.

</details>


### [340] [REFLEX: Reflective Evolution from LLM Experience](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16496)
*Pan Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: REFLEX提出了一种无训练框架，将视觉诊断与代码生成解耦，利用视觉Critic提取结构化诊断、文本Actor结合技能记忆合成策略，在多个控制任务和天线阵列合成任务中实现了高样本效率与可审计的策略搜索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大型多模态语言模型引导进化搜索的方法将视觉行为证据解释与纠错代码生成耦合在单一模型调用中，导致诊断-修复纠缠，产生不透明的反馈回路，掩盖突变原理且无法跨运行保留算法见解。

Method: REFLEX采用无训练进化框架，包含：(1) 视觉Critic，将特定任务的视觉行为证据蒸馏为结构化、可审计的诊断；(2) 文本Actor，利用诊断结果和自进化的技能记忆库（可复用代码片段）合成子代策略，实现诊断与代码生成的解耦。

Result: 在Lunar Lander、Acrobot、Pendulum控制基准和36维天线阵列合成任务上，REFLEX表现出卓越的样本效率：Acrobot和Pendulum在10次LLM调用内解决，Lunar Lander达到1.092的最佳归一化加权分数，显著加速了透明策略的早期发现。

Conclusion: 视觉诊断与代码生成的结构化解耦能够实现可审计、高效的策略搜索，提供透明的突变追踪和跨运行程序化知识迁移，为多模态LLM引导的进化优化提供了新范式。

Abstract: Large multimodal language models (LLMs) have emerged as powerful tools for guiding evolutionary search toward interpretable programmatic policies. However, existing frameworks rely on a monolithic model call to simultaneously interpret visual behavioral evidence and synthesize corrective code. This diagnosis-repair entanglement creates an opaque feedback loop, obscuring the rationale behind mutations and preventing the retention of algorithmic insights across independent runs. To achieve auditable and efficient policy search, we argue that visual diagnosis must be structurally decoupled from code generation. We present REFLEX, a train-free evolutionary framework that operationalizes this decoupling. In REFLEX, a vision-enabled Critic first distills task-specific behavioral evidence into structured, auditable diagnoses. Subsequently, a text-optimized Actor synthesizes child policies using these diagnoses alongside a persistent, self-evolving Skill Memory of reusable code snippets. This architecture not only provides transparent mutation traces but also enables cross-run programmatic knowledge transfer. Extensive evaluations across control benchmarks (Lunar Lander, Acrobot, Pendulum) and a 36-dimensional antenna array synthesis task demonstrate exceptional sample efficiency. Notably, REFLEX solves Acrobot and Pendulum in under 10 LLM calls and reaches a best Normalized Weighted Score of 1.092 on Lunar Lander, achieving highly competitive final performance while significantly accelerating the early-stage discovery of transparent policies.

</details>


### [341] [SkillWiki: A Living Knowledge Infrastructure for Agent Skills](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16523)
*Dingcheng Huang,Yuda Ding,Bingshuo Liu,Qingbin Liu,Xi Chen,Jiang Bian,Hongliang Sun,Zhiying Tu,Dianhui Chu,Xiaoyan Yu,Dianbo Sui*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: SkillWiki是一个支持智能体技能大规模生产、治理和持续演进的知识基础设施，将异构知识转化为可复用的技能资产，实现知识、技能和执行经验的协同演化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前知识通过维基百科管理，软件通过GitHub管理，但智能体技能缺乏大规模生产、治理和演进的基础设施。

Method: 构建SkillWiki基础设施，支持知识摄入、技能生产、溯源探索、治理和执行驱动的持续演化，将异构知识转化为与原始证据关联的可复用技能资产。

Result: 展示了完整的技能生命周期，包括知识摄入、技能生产、溯源探索、治理和执行驱动演化，代码和演示已公开。

Conclusion: SkillWiki展望了知识、技能和执行经验在共享基础设施中协同演化的未来。

Abstract: While knowledge is managed through Wikipedia and software through GitHub, agent skills still lack an infrastructure for large-scale production, governance, and evolution. SkillWiki is a living knowledge infrastructure that supports the organization, grounding, and continuous evolution of agent skills by transforming heterogeneous knowledge into reusable skill assets linked to their originating evidence. Our demonstration presents the complete skill lifecycle, from knowledge ingestion and skill production to provenance-aware exploration, governance, and execution-driven evolution. SkillWiki highlights a future in which knowledge, skills, and execution experience co-evolve within a shared infrastructure. The live demonstration and source code are publicly available at https://github.com/Huangdingcheng/SkillWiki.

</details>


### [342] [Can LLM Coding Agents Reason About Time Series?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16545)
*Filip Rechtorík,Ondřej Dušek,Zdeněk Kasner*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文探讨了LLM代理在时间序列分析中的三种方法：处理原始数据、作为代码代理、或两者结合。代码代理性能最优，可提升高达10%的准确率，但仍有22-34%的问题回答错误。通过LLM裁判分析发现，代码代理能选择合适统计检验但常忽略重要细节，而处理原始数据的模型则能通过粗略计算得出正确结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM在金融、医疗、环境监测等领域的自动化决策系统中广泛应用，时间序列数据的自动处理成为关键挑战。现有研究缺乏对LLM代理在时间序列分析任务中不同方法（原始数据处理、代码代理、混合方法）的系统比较和深入分析。

Method: 研究了三种LLM代理的时间序列分析方案：1) 直接提供原始数值数据；2) 将LLM作为代码代理，通过Python代码迭代查询数据；3) 两者的结合。使用两个时间序列理解基准进行评估，并借助强LLM裁判分析模型的输出策略和推理差距。

Result: 代码代理相比处理原始数据的模型性能提升高达10%；但最佳代理仍有22-34%的问题回答错误。代码代理能选择恰当的统计检验但常遗漏重要细微差别；处理原始数据的模型可通过粗略计算（back-of-the-envelope calculations）得出正确结论。

Conclusion: 代码访问能显著提升LLM代理在时间序列分析中的表现，但当前最佳方案仍存在较大改进空间。两种方法各有优劣：代码代理擅长统计检验但缺乏领域细微洞察，原始数据处理模型能进行快速估算但整体表现较弱。未来需进一步提升LLM代理在时间序列任务中的推理能力。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being used for automated decision-making systems in finance, healthcare, or environmental monitoring. Time series data are ubiquitous in these fields, yet hard to process automatically. Can time series be analyzed by LLM agents? We examine three approaches: providing the agent with raw numerical data, using the LLM as a coding agent, or a combination of both. In the coding agent setup, the model iteratively queries the data using Python code. Using two time series understanding benchmarks, we show that agents with code access can outperform models processing raw data by up to 10%. However, even the best performing agent still answers about 22-34% of the questions incorrectly. To get insights into models' strategies and reasoning gaps, we analyze the model outputs with a strong LLM judge. Our analysis reveals that coding agents can select appropriate statistical tests, but often miss important nuances. Meanwhile, models with access to raw data can reach the right conclusions using back-of-the-envelope calculations.

</details>


### [343] [The BD-LSC Dataset: Facilitating the Benchmarking of Models for Lexical Semantic Change Detection in Slang and Standard Usage](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16560)
*Afnan Aloraini,Viktor Schlegel,Goran Nenadic,Riza Batista-Navarro*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文针对现有词汇语义变化检测未能充分捕获双向语义变化（尤其是同时具有俚语和标准用法的词汇）的问题，提出了两个互补的基准数据集：BD-LSC（追踪语义获得/丢失/稳定）和SlangTrack WSD（提供俚语与标准用法的细粒度实例级标注）。系统评估显示，少样本GPT-4o在精确语义匹配和多标签准确率上表现最佳，但所有系统的Macro-F1均在0.5左右，表明罕见俚语语义仍是核心挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有词汇语义变化（LSC）基准和方法难以捕获双向语义变化（同时获得和丢失义项），尤其是同时具有俚语和标准用法的词汇，缺乏针对此类复杂语义轨迹和俚语消歧的系统性基准。

Method: 提出两个互补基准数据集：BD-LSC（三个时间段的语义获得/丢失/稳定性标注）和SlangTrack WSD（俚语与标准用法的实例级消歧标注）。系统评估跨越无监督聚类、有监督机器学习、Transformer模型和大型语言模型等多个方法论家族。

Result: 少样本GPT-4o在ESM和多标签准确率上表现最强；但所有系统的Macro-F1均接近0.5，表明罕见俚语语义的检测仍是核心难点。

Conclusion: 自动语义变化检测面临双向语义变化和俚语消歧的挑战，现有方法在罕见俚语语义上表现不足，该方向是未来研究的核心开放问题。

Abstract: Automatic semantic change detection aims to identify how word meanings shift over time, offering insights into both linguistic and societal change. Despite recent progress in computational lexical semantic change (LSC), existing benchmarks and methods struggle to capture bi-directional semantic change, particularly cases where words simultaneously gain and lose senses. This problem is especially challenging for words that have both slang and standard meanings. To address these gaps, we introduce two complementary benchmark datasets. The Bi-Directional Lexical Semantic Change (BD-LSC) dataset captures sense gain, sense loss, and stability across three time periods, enabling the study of complex semantic trajectories. The SlangTrack Word Sense Disambiguation (ST-WSD) dataset provides fine-grained, instance-level sense annotations for words combining slang and standard usages, supporting systematic benchmarking of WSD and semantic change detection models. Using these benchmarks, we systematically evaluate models across different methodological families: unsupervised clustering using contextualised embeddings, supervised machine learning, transformer-based models, and state-of-the-art large language models. Among the evaluated systems, the few-shot GPT-4o model achieved the strongest aggregate performance on Exact Sense Match (ESM) and multi-label accuracy; however, Macro-F1 scores near 0.5 across all systems show that rare slang senses remain difficult, which we identify as the central open challenge.

</details>


### [344] [Fast When, Careful Who: Dual-Process Multiparty Turn-Taking with Diffusion Augmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16568)
*Rutherford A. Patamia,Ming Liu,Wei Luo,Favour Ekong,Akan Cosgun*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 针对多说话人对话场景中的可靠话轮转换问题，提出了一种音频-only的两阶段流水线：快速触发器扫描音频并提议候选话轮结束点，轻量级验证器在这些时间点决定保持或转移并预测下一说话人。在VoxConverse数据集上，该方法改善了转移检测效果，扩散增强进一步提升了性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有话轮转换方法主要针对双人交互设计，难以处理多人音频中的重叠和快速说话人切换问题，需要一种能适应真实多说话人场景的可靠话轮转换方法。

Method: 提出两阶段流水线：(1) 快速触发器扫描音频，提出候选话轮结束时间；(2) 轻量级验证器仅在这些时间点运行，判断保持(Hold)或转移(Shift)，并支持下一说话人预测。同时采用基于扩散的、标签保留的背景音频混合作为数据增强策略。

Result: 在完全多说话人设置和受控双人投影设置下报告结果。相比基线方法，转移检测性能得到提升，扩散增强进一步带来改进。

Conclusion: 提出的两阶段流水线能有效处理多人对话中的话轮转换，扩散数据增强策略有助于提升模型性能。

Abstract: Reliable turn-taking is essential for spoken dialogue systems. However, most existing methods are designed for two-speaker interaction and struggle with realistic multiparty audio containing overlap and rapid speaker changes. We study multiparty turn-taking on the VoxConverse dataset and propose an audio-only two-stage pipeline that separates when to trigger a turn boundary from whether the floor is actually transferring. A fast trigger scans the audio and proposes candidate end-of-turn times, while a lightweight verifier runs only at those times to decide \textsc{Hold} or \textsc{Shift} and support next-speaker prediction. We report results in the full multiparty setting and a controlled dyadic top-2 projection for comparability. We also investigate diffusion-based, label-preserving background-audio mixing as a data augmentation strategy. Results show improved shift detection over a baseline, with further improvements from diffusion augmentation.

</details>


### [345] [Can LLM Agents Infer World Models? Evidence from Agentic Automata Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16576)
*Reef Menaged,Gili Lior,Shauli Ravfogel,Roee Aharoni,Gabriel Stanovsky*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于agent的自动机学习框架，用于评估工具调用型LLM代理通过交互发现隐藏环境的能力。实验表明，LLM代理在DFA规模增大时性能急剧下降，推理模型优于非推理模型，但在查询规划、证据整合和假设构建方面存在系统性缺陷，整体远不如经典算法鲁棒高效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的LLM代理评估多关注静态任务或简单交互，缺乏对代理通过主动交互发现未知环境结构能力的系统性、可控性评估。本文旨在构建一个可扩展的测试平台，量化评估LLM代理在结构化环境探索中的交互效率与推理能力。

Method: 采用经典的自动机学习范式（Angluin的L*算法），将隐藏的确定性有限自动机（DFA）作为目标，让LLM代理通过与oracle的成员查询和等价查询两种交互方式逐步揭示目标DFA。实验对比了多种主流LLM（包括推理模型和非推理模型），并与经典自动机学习算法进行基线比较。

Result: LLM代理性能随DFA规模增大而急剧下降；推理模型显著优于非推理模型；但轨迹分析显示代理在查询规划（query planning）、证据整合（evidence integration）和假设构建（hypothesis construction）三个关键环节存在重复性失败模式。

Conclusion: 当前LLM代理虽能在某些情况下完成非平凡的交互式发现任务，但其鲁棒性和效率远不及经典算法，在结构化探索任务中仍有本质性局限。

Abstract: We propose agentic automata learning to evaluate the extent to which tool-calling LLM agents can uncover hidden environments through interaction. In our setup, an agent should uncover a hidden deterministic finite automaton (DFA) by interacting with an oracle through (1) membership queries ("Does this string belong to the target language?") and (2) equivalence queries ("Is this the target DFA?"). This yields a scalable testbed with controlled task complexity, measurable interaction efficiency, and strong baselines (classic automata-learning algorithms). Evaluating state-of-the-art LLMs, we find that performance drops sharply as DFA size increases. Reasoning models are markedly stronger than non-reasoning models, yet trajectory analyses reveal recurring failures in query planning, evidence integration, and hypothesis construction. Overall, our results show that current LLM agents can sometimes perform non-trivial interactive discovery, but remain far less robust and efficient than classic algorithms for the task.

</details>


### [346] [Uncertainty Is Not a Safety Net for Clinical VQA, but Can It Anticipate Model Failure?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16583)
*Arnisa Fazla,Alberto Testoni,Ameen Abu-Hanna,Barbara Plank,Iacer Calixto*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文评估了12个临床视觉语言模型在8种不确定性估计方法下的表现，发现UE质量非方法固有属性，而是随模型准确率波动；在NOTA扰动下准确率骤降但不确定性变化微小；然而未扰动输入的不确定性可有效预测模型在扰动下的崩溃，表明UE可作为诊断模型脆弱性的工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床视觉语言模型的安全部署需要可靠的不确定性估计，以指示何时应信任预测或上报临床医生，但当前UE方法是否真正提供这种信号尚不明确。

Method: 在12个临床VLM上基准测试8种UE方法，在临床视觉问答任务上进行评估，并引入NOTA扰动（隐藏正确选项）进行压力测试。

Result: UE质量与模型准确率高度相关，在模型最薄弱处表现最差；NOTA扰动导致准确率崩溃但不确定性几乎不变；然而未扰动输入的不确定性可可靠预测模型在NOTA下的崩溃。

Conclusion: 不确定性估计可作为诊断工具识别脆弱预测，并推动基于扰动的评估作为临床安全部署的路径。

Abstract: Safe deployment of clinical vision-language models (VLMs) requires reliable uncertainty estimation (UE): a signal indicating when predictions should be trusted or escalated to a clinician. We test whether current UE methods actually deliver this signal. Benchmarking 8 methods across 12 VLMs on clinical visual question-answering (VQA), we find that UE quality is not an intrinsic property of the UE method: it tracks model accuracy, degrading precisely where the model performance is weakest, and therefore where reliability is most needed. When we stress-test models by hiding the correct option among the multiple-choice answers (NOTA perturbations), accuracy collapses while uncertainty barely changes, leaving models systematically miscalibrated. Yet, we find that uncertainty on the unperturbed input reliably anticipates which predictions will collapse under NOTA, indicating that UE in current VLMs carries diagnostic information about model fragility. Our results position UE as a diagnostic tool for identifying fragile predictions and motivate perturbation-based evaluation as a path toward safe clinical deployment.

</details>


### [347] [SING: Synthetic Intention Graph for Scalable Active Tool Discovery in LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16591)
*Qiao Xiao,Haochen Shi,Yisen Gao,Wenbin Hu,Huihao Jing,Tianshi Zheng,Baixuan Xu,Ziheng Zhang,Weiqi Wang,Haoran Li,Jiaxin Bai,Yangqiu Song*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出SING框架，通过构建意图-工具图实现动态工具发现，在7471个工具的数据集上，全局召回率提升59.8%，下游任务成功率提升28.9%，同时减少99.8%的工具模式暴露。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM智能体依赖静态工具清单，随着工具生态扩大，全量注入成本高且限制智能体能力；一阶段检索方法无法对齐工具描述与真实任务意图，尤其在长程任务中工具需求随状态演化。

Method: 构建意图-工具图，连接用户意图、工具能力和工具协作模式；根据演化任务状态动态检索工具。

Result: 在7471个工具的语料库上，Global Recall@5提升最高59.8%，下游成功率提升最高28.9%，全语料工具模式暴露减少99.8%。

Conclusion: 意图感知的图结构能够在大规模智能体生态中实现更准确且上下文高效的工具发现。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on agent harnesses that manage context, tools, and multi-turn execution, making tools a central interface for acting in realistic digital environments. As harness-connected tool ecosystems expand to hundreds or thousands of APIs, services, and task-specific skills, exhaustive tool schema injection becomes costly and imposes a closed-world assumption that limits agents to a predefined static inventory. Retrieval-augmented tool selection offers a natural alternative, but existing one-shot retrieval methods often fail to align isolated tool descriptions with the agent's true task intention, especially in long-horizon tasks where required capabilities emerge through decomposition, observations, and newly induced subgoals. We propose SING, an intention-aware active tool discovery framework that builds an intention-tool graph linking user intentions, tool capabilities, and tool collaboration patterns, and dynamically retrieves tools according to evolving task states. Using a unified corpus of 7,471 tools, we evaluate SING on three real-world tool-use benchmarks. SING improves Global Recall@5 by up to 59.8% and downstream success rate by up to 28.9% over baselines, while reducing full-corpus tool-schema exposure by 99.8%, demonstrating that intention-aware graph structure enables more accurate and context-efficient tool discovery in large-scale agentic ecosystems.

</details>


### [348] [How Far Can Machine Translation Quality Take You? Extrinsic Discourse Evaluation in Goal-Oriented Setups](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16596)
*Wafaa Mohammed,Kata Naszadi,Vlad Niculae*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出两种外部评估机制（静态实体计数任务和交互式多智能体外交游戏）来评估机器翻译的语篇一致性，发现高内在翻译质量无法可靠预测下游语篇成功，且交互中的翻译失败会影响智能体间的协调能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器翻译评估主要关注内在质量，缺乏对翻译错误在下游任务中后果的衡量，因此需要构建面向语篇的外部评估框架。

Method: 在静态机制下提出实体计数任务探测语篇指代一致性；在交互机制下利用面向目标的多人外交游戏探测长程通信与协调中的翻译效果。

Result: 高内在翻译质量不能可靠预测下游语篇成功；强MT系统仍会产生指代不一致；交互中的翻译失败会影响智能体间的协调能力。

Conclusion: 面向目标的环境为语篇敏感的外部机器翻译评估提供了可行框架。

Abstract: Existing machine translation (MT) metrics and discourse-focused evaluations primarily assess translation quality intrinsically, without measuring the downstream consequences of translation errors. In this work, we focus on extrinsic discourse evaluation of machine translation under two distinct regimes: static and interactive. Under the static regime, we propose an entity counting task as a probe of referential consistency in discourse. We show that high intrinsic MT quality does not reliably predict downstream discourse success and strong MT systems still produce referential inconsistencies. For the interactive regime, we study the goal-oriented multi-agent Welfare Diplomacy game as a probe of long-horizon communication and coordination. We find that interaction-specific translation failures impact downstream coordination. Our results highlight goal-oriented environments as a viable framework for discourse-sensitive extrinsic MT evaluation.

</details>


### [349] [VeriGraph: Towards Verifiable Data-Analytic Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16603)
*Jiajie Jin,Zhao Yang,Wenle Liao,Yuyang Hu,Guanting Dong,Xiaoxi Li,Yutao Zhu,Zhicheng Dou*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: VeriGraph提出了一种可追踪的神经符号推理框架，通过构建异构证据有向无环图（DAG）来使LLM智能体的推理过程可审计，实验表明该方法在答案正确性和证据可追溯性上均优于基线模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于LLM的智能体在数据分析任务中表现出色，但其输出难以验证：线性文本轨迹使得推理过程难以审计。数值计算与语义推理的混杂导致结论难以复现和检查。

Method: 提出VeriGraph框架，引入三种证据扩展原语（计算扩展、基础扩展、推导扩展），将原始数据、解释器变量、计算结果和自然语言声明连接成统一的异构证据DAG。将结构可追溯性转化为图可达性问题，并设计基于图的策略优化方法，使用复合奖励联合监督答案正确性、计算完整性和推导一致性。

Result: 在四个基准测试上，VeriGraph-8B取得最高总体得分；在声明级证据支持评估中达到87.61%的Grounding Rate。

Conclusion: 显式的证据图构建是实现可验证数据分析智能体的有前景的路径。

Abstract: LLM-based agents have demonstrated strong capabilities in data-intensive analytical tasks, yet their outputs are rarely verifiable: a reliance on linear text trajectories makes their reasoning difficult to audit. In particular, deterministic computations over raw data and semantic deductions over natural-language claims are often entangled in an unstructured stream, leaving numerical conclusions hard to reproduce and qualitative judgments hard to inspect. To address this, we propose VeriGraph, a traceable neuro-symbolic reasoning framework that enables agents to construct an explicit heterogeneous evidence directed acyclic graph (DAG) during execution. VeriGraph introduces three evidence-expansion primitives, namely computational, grounding, and derivational expansion, to connect raw data, interpreter variables, computed results, and natural-language claims in a unified graph. Under this formulation, structural traceability is reduced to graph reachability from raw data sources to terminal claims, while semantic support is measured by claim-level evidence evaluation. To improve graph construction, we further design a graph-based policy optimization strategy with a composite reward that jointly supervises answer correctness, computational integrity, and derivational coherence. Experiments on four benchmarks show that VeriGraph-8B achieves the highest overall score among all baselines. More importantly, VeriGraph produces auditable evidence graphs with substantially stronger claim grounding, achieving a 87.61\% Grounding Rate under our claim-level evidence support evaluation. These results suggest that explicit evidence-graph construction is a promising path toward verifiable data-analytic agents. Our code is available at https://github.com/ignorejjj/VeriGraph.

</details>


### [350] [Sycophancy as Material Failure under Pushback Loading: A Multi-Axis Characterization Across Three Loading Cases and up to Seventeen Material Charges](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16617)
*Ferdinand M. Schessl*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文采用材料科学框架，通过多轴测量（速度、损伤累积、框架漂移、脆性、方向稳定性等14个轮次级指标及3个说话者解析指标）对LLM的谄媚行为（sycophancy）进行表征。在辩论（n=1000）、虚假预设（n=3400）和伦理设定（n=3400）三种加载条件下，对7800个测试样本进行分析，发现谄媚行为失败模式可分为两类：辩论场景为脆性断裂型（材料等级主导），虚假预设和伦理设定为蠕变型（载荷主导）。跨评判者信度分析显示辩论场景具有评判者鲁棒性（Cohen's κ=0.88），而虚假预设场景对评判者敏感（κ=0.36）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有70余篇论文记录了LLM的谄媚行为，但专家对其构念边界的共识极低（ICC=.184），原因在于行为分类依赖于所特权的表面形式。需要一种不依赖特定表面形式的多轴表征方法。

Method: 采用材料科学框架，将对话视为受载测试样本，LLM模型视为材料电荷，反驳（pushback）为渐进载荷，立场翻转（stance-flip）为材料失效。在三种加载条件下使用14个轮次级轴测量（速度、损伤累积、框架漂移、脆性、方向稳定性）及3个说话者解析轴，通过Hooke耦合（σ=E·ε类比）进行分析。

Result: 辩论场景下效应量达|r_rb|=0.35；伦理设定场景反转了速度和累积模块的符号结构。方差组成分为两种轮廓：辩论为电荷主导（脆性断裂型），虚假预设和伦理设定为主题主导（蠕变型），比值分别为2.03 vs 0.13/0.17。跨评判者信度：辩论场景Cohen's κ=0.88（稳健），虚假预设场景κ=0.36（敏感）。

Conclusion: 本文提出的多轴表征方法不依赖于构念的特定表面形式，回应了Ye等人诊断的方法学需求。同时指出单评判者基准必须报告跨评判者信度这一注意事项。

Abstract: Sycophancy in LLMs is documented across 70+ papers, but expert agreement on construct boundaries remains low (ICC=.184; Ye et al., 2026). The construct fragments because behavioral classification depends on which surface form is privileged. We adopt a materials-science framing: conversation as test specimen under load, LLM-model as material charge, pushback as progressive load, stance-flip as material failure. We characterize this failure across three loading cases (debate n=1000; false-presuppositions n=3400; ethical-setting n=3400; 10-17 material charges per case; 7800 specimens total) using 14 turn-level axis-measurements spanning velocity, damage accumulation, frame-drift, brittleness, and direction stability, plus three speaker-resolved axes from an independent pipeline. The measurements are Hooke-coupled ($σ= E \cdot \varepsilon$ analog) and reproduce across loading cases with effects up to $|r_{rb}| = 0.35$ on debate; the sign structure adds a second pattern: the ethical-setting case inverts the velocity and accumulation blocks. Variance composition partitions into two profiles: debate is charge-dominated (brittle-fracture-like: the material grade decides), false-presuppositions and ethical-setting are topic-dominated (creep-like: the load decides); the ratios (2.03 vs 0.13/0.17) are estimator-dependent, for debate even in direction. Cross-judge reliability (GPT-4o vs Haiku 4.5) shows debate scoring is judge-robust (Cohen's $κ= 0.88$) while false-presupposition scoring is judge-sensitive ($κ= 0.36$) -- a caveat single-judge benchmarks must report. This is the methodological move Ye et al.'s diagnosis calls for: a multi-axis characterization that does not depend on which surface form of the construct one privileges.

</details>


### [351] [Islamic Large Language Models: From Knowledge Acquisition to Trustworthy and Hallucination-Resistant AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16629)
*Mohammed Amine Mouhoub*

Main category: cs.CL
