TL;DR: 本文综述了面向伊斯兰知识领域的大语言模型（LLMs）与可信伊斯兰AI的研究现状，指出仅具备阿拉伯语流利度不足以构建可靠的伊斯兰AI系统，必须整合经源检索、引文验证、教法学派感知推理、人工专家评估等多维度保障机制，并提出抵御幻觉的研究议程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 伊斯兰知识问答要求答案基于权威经源、引文精确、处理古典阿拉伯语与方言差异，并需呈现合法的教法学派分歧而非单一答案，这对LLMs构成独特且严峻的挑战，亟需专门的系统性综述来指导该领域发展。

Method: 以综述形式系统梳理文献，围绕阿拉伯语NLP与以阿拉伯语为中心的LLMs、伊斯兰NLP资源、《古兰经》问答、伊斯兰知识基准、检索增强生成（RAG）、伊斯兰法律推理、继承推理、幻觉评估与可信度等关键主题进行组织与分析。

Result: 识别出构建可信伊斯兰AI的核心要求：需要经过整理的经源、检索与验证模块、引文感知生成、教法学派感知推理、人工专家评估，以及测量准确性、忠实度、来源有效性和推理质量的基准。

Conclusion: 阿拉伯语流利度不足以支撑伊斯兰AI；需建立抗幻觉的伊斯兰AI系统，并提出了未来研究议程。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for knowledge-intensive question answering, including religious and legal questions. Islamic knowledge is a particularly demanding setting: answers are expected to be grounded in authoritative sources, citations must be exact, Arabic varieties differ substantially from the language of classical sources, and legitimate jurisprudential disagreement must be represented rather than collapsed into a single answer. This survey reviews the emerging field of Islamic LLMs and trustworthy Islamic AI. We organize the literature around Arabic NLP and Arabic-centric LLMs, Islamic NLP resources, Qur'anic question answering, Islamic knowledge benchmarks, retrieval-augmented generation, Islamic legal reasoning, inheritance reasoning, hallucination evaluation, and trustworthiness. We argue that fluency in Arabic is not sufficient for Islamic AI. Reliable systems require curated sources, retrieval and verification modules, citation-aware generation, madhhab-aware reasoning, human expert evaluation, and benchmarks that measure not only answer accuracy but also faithfulness, source validity, and reasoning quality. The survey concludes with a research agenda for hallucination-resistant Islamic AI systems.

</details>


### [352] [FraudSMSWalker: Benchmarking Agentic Large Language Models for SMS-to-Webpage Fraud Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16659)
*Y. H. Zhou,Z. M. Ma,Y. J. Zhou,Y. T. Li,H. X. Xiang,Y. M. Cheng,T. L. Chen,K. J. Zhang,Z. H. Nan,J. H. Ni,Z. Wu,Q. Y. Pan,S. Zhang,S. Cheng,M. Y. Luo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出FraudSMSWalker基准，用于评估在URL被屏蔽条件下，Web代理能否基于SMS上下文和网页证据准确判断短信诈骗，避免依赖域名声誉捷径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有短信诈骗检测要么只关注短信文本分类，要么暴露URL/域名信息使模型依赖声誉捷径，无法评估模型在跨渠道诈骗（短信→网页）中的真实判断能力。

Method: 构建699条双语（中英）短信-网页链条（332欺诈/367良性），覆盖10类服务场景。模型输入仅含短信上下文和脱敏网页证据，隐藏URL、域名、IP、重定向和声誉元数据；含硬负例（网页含登录/支付等易混淆元素）。采用掩码浏览器协议评估9种Web代理，并进行URL可见性消融实验。

Result: 当前Web代理能检测可疑线索，但难以保持良性样本的召回率，且许多正向预测缺乏充分的证据支撑。

Conclusion: FraudSMSWalker可作为衡量Web代理在抑制声誉捷径条件下，能否做出准确且基于证据的诈骗判断的标准基准。

Abstract: SMS fraud is increasingly cross-channel: a message directs the user to a webpage, and the final risk depends on how the SMS claim aligns with the page content and requested user action. However, existing evaluations either focus on message-only smishing classification or expose URL and domain cues that allow models to rely on reputation shortcuts. To address this gap, we introduce \textbf{FraudSMSWalker}, a controlled benchmark for URL-masked SMS-to-webpage fraud judgment. FraudSMSWalker contains 699 bilingual chains, including 332 fraudulent and 367 benign cases, across ten service scenarios. The model-visible input consists of the SMS context and sanitized webpage evidence, while raw URLs, hosts, domains, IPs, redirects, and reputation metadata are withheld. The benchmark further includes hard benign cases whose pages contain login, payment, verification, or account-management elements that are plausible under the service context but also appear in scam flows. We evaluate nine web agents under masked browser-agent protocols and conduct URL-visibility ablations. The results show that current agents can detect suspicious cues, but struggle to preserve benign recall and often produce positive predictions that are weakly supported by the observed evidence. These findings position FraudSMSWalker as a benchmark for measuring whether web agents can make fraud judgments that remain both accurate and evidence-grounded when direct reputation shortcuts are suppressed. The associated code and dataset are accessible at the \href{https://anonymous.4open.science/w/FraudMessageWalker-Bench}{anonymous link}.

</details>


### [353] [Progressive Knowledge-Guided Large Language Model Framework for Bearing Fault Diagnosis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16684)
*Jinghan Wang,Gaoliang Peng,Yanjun Chen,Wei Zhang,Wentao Wu,Tianchen Liu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出了一种渐进式物理引导的多尺度振动信号处理框架，通过81维物理可追溯特征描述符、故障自适应分割机制和隐式故障知识编码，在四个公开数据集上实现了98.49%的诊断精度，同时计算成本降低了12.6倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决基于振动的轴承故障诊断中三个相互关联的测量挑战：全局统计特征效率与局部瞬态信号保真度之间的权衡、测量特征对底层故障物理的可追溯性不足、以及跨诊断尺度的多源测量信息融合效果不佳。

Method: 构建了81维物理可追溯测量描述符（基于轴承运动学和特征缺陷频率）；设计了故障自适应信号分割机制，利用物理先验引导关注故障相关波形区域；在训练过程中将结构化故障机理知识隐式编码到模型参数中，实现自主多尺度测量融合。

Result: 在四个公开基准数据集上实现98.49%的诊断准确率，计算成本相比信号级基线降低12.6倍，诊断特征激活与轴承故障力学机制一致。

Conclusion: 该框架有效解决了轴承故障诊断中的三个关键测量挑战，兼具高精度、低计算成本与良好的物理可解释性，适用于安全关键工业系统。

Abstract: Vibration-based bearing fault diagnosis requires resolving three interrelated measurement challenges, including the trade-off between global statistical feature efficiency and local transient signal fidelity, insufficient traceability of measurement features to underlying fault physics, and ineffective multi-source measurement information fusion across diagnostic scales. This paper presents a progressive physics-guided multi-scale vibration signal processing framework that addresses all three challenges within a unified diagnostic pipeline. An 81-dimensional measurement descriptor, derived from bearing kinematic theory and characteristic defect frequencies, establishes a physically traceable feature space enabling real-time fault screening at approximately 20 ms per sample. A fault-adaptive signal segmentation mechanism then directs analytical attention toward fault-relevant waveform regions guided by physics-based priors, without manual feature engineering. Structured fault mechanism knowledge is further encoded implicitly in model parameters during training, enabling autonomous multi-scale measurement fusion without external knowledge dependencies at inference. Validated on four public benchmark datasets under diverse operating conditions, the framework achieves 98.49% diagnostic accuracy with a 12.6-fold reduction in computational cost relative to signal-level baselines. Interpretability analysis confirms that diagnostic feature activations align with established bearing fault mechanics, supporting measurement traceability in safety-critical industrial systems.

</details>


### [354] [Multi-Turn Reflective Masking Elicits Reasoning in Mask Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16700)
*Yanming Zhang,Yihan Bian,Jingyuan Qi,Yuguang Yao,Lifu Huang,Tianyi Zhou*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出Reflective Masking (RM)，利用掩码扩散模型固有的局部编辑能力，通过轻量级后训练实现多轮掩码与去噪推理，无需架构修改即可在文本生成、数独和图像编辑等任务中超越标准基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归模型依赖完全顺序生成进行反思修正，即使只需要局部编辑；而掩码扩散模型天然支持局部编辑，但现有模型不支持多轮掩码与去噪，无法像人类一样通过迭代局部修正来纠错。

Method: 提出Reflective Masking (RM)，通过轻量级后训练使MDM具备多轮掩码与去噪能力；引入History Reference机制，利用先前轮次的中间去噪状态来借鉴自回归推理的洞察，无需参数即可实现。

Result: 在文本生成、数独和图像编辑等多个任务和模态上，RM一致优于标准掩码基线，展现出强泛化能力。

Conclusion: RM作为MDM上的基本推理原语，无需架构修改即可实现原生测试时扩展，为掩码扩散模型赋予迭代反思与修正能力。

Abstract: While reasoning on autoregressive (AR) models is often performed by chain-of-thought reasoning and reflection, their refinement of previous outputs still relies on fully sequential generation, even when only local edits are needed. In contrast, the masking mechanism in Mask Diffusion Models (MDMs) naturally supports explicit local edits on previous outputs, allowing selective refinement without discarding previous answers and generating another from scratch. While this property more closely aligns with how humans correct mistakes by iterative local refinement, existing MDMs do not support multi-turn masking and denoising. We propose Reflective Masking (RM), which elicits such an intrinsic reasoning capability in MDMs via lightweight post-training. RM provides a native test-time scaling, where an MDM iteratively revisits and revises its prior outputs based on evolving context. To exploit insights from previous turns like AR reasoning, we further introduce History Reference, a parameter-free mechanism that leverages intermediate denoising states during revision. Our approach requires no architectural changes and is easily applicable to existing MDMs. Across diverse tasks and modalities, including text generation, Sudoku, and image editing, Reflective Masking consistently outperforms standard masking-based baselines and demonstrates strong generality, positioning RM as a fundamental primitive for reasoning on MDMs.

</details>


### [355] [P3B3: A Multi-Turn Conversational Benchmark for Measuring European and Brazilian Portuguese Variety Bias in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16753)
*Rafael Ferreira,Inês Vieira,Inês Calvo,James Furtado,Iago Paulo,Diogo Tavares,Diogo Glória-Silva,David Semedo,João Magalhães*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出P3B3基准，用于评估大型语言模型在葡萄牙语欧洲变体（pt-PT）和巴西变体（pt-BR）之间的偏差与可控性。实验表明，多数LLM严重偏向pt-BR，且不同模型的可控性存在差异，揭示了语言变体表示不平衡的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM融入日常交流，捕获区域语言变体对实现可靠和公平的语言使用至关重要。葡萄牙语的欧洲变体（pt-PT）和巴西变体（pt-BR）在数据量上存在显著不平衡，pt-BR占主导地位，但LLM对葡萄牙语变体的偏好尚未得到充分探索。

Method: 提出了P3B3基准，这是一个由专家策划的语言变体无关的对话提示基准，同时设计了评估框架用于衡量变体偏差和可控性。

Result: 在多个模型上的实验表明，大多数LLM表现出强烈的pt-BR偏向，不同模型在可控性方面存在差异。

Conclusion: 研究结果突显了在语言变体之间实现更平衡的多语言表示的必要性。

Abstract: As Large Language Models (LLMs) become embedded in everyday communication, capturing regional linguistic variation is essential for reliable and equitable language use. In Portuguese, European (pt-PT) and Brazilian (pt-BR) varieties remain unevenly represented, with pt-BR dominating in data quantity, while LLM preference for Portuguese variants remains underexplored. To address this gap, we introduce P3B3, an expert-curated language variety agnostic benchmark of conversational prompts, along with an evaluation framework for measuring variety bias and controllability. Experiments on several models show that most LLMs exhibit a strong bias toward pt-BR, with variation in controllability across models. These results highlight the need for more balanced multilingual representation across language varieties.

</details>


### [356] [The Art of Mixology: Mixup-based Obfuscation for Privacy-Preserving Split Learning in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16801)
*Chen Chen,Xiang Gao,Xianshun Wang,Chengran Li,Shengyu Xia,Xueluan Gong,Linru Zhang,Qian Wang,Kwok-Yan Lam*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: MIXGUARD是一种基于混合（mixup）的隐私保护分割学习框架，通过令牌级混淆、表征级混淆和自适应梯度扰动三种机制协同工作，在保护大语言模型分割学习中隐私的同时保持模型效用。实验表明，该方法在多个任务上达到与无分割训练相当的效用，并能有效抵御先进的数据重建攻击。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的隐私保护分割学习方法在效用、隐私、效率和稳定性之间存在难以平衡的困境：要么遭受严重的效用退化，要么对高级数据重建攻击依然脆弱，要么产生过高的计算和通信开销，或在不同任务上表现不稳定。

Method: MIXGUARD提出三种协同机制：1) 令牌级混淆（token-level obfuscation）；2) 表征级混淆（representation-level obfuscation）；3) 自适应梯度扰动（adaptive gradient perturbation）。技术流程上，先在公开数据集上构建轻量级校准模型以精炼近似目标表征，随后将该模型应用于私有数据上的隐私保护微调。

Result: 在四个分类任务和四个文本生成任务上，涵盖多种LLM家族、模型规模、架构和微调策略的实验表明：MIXGUARD保持了与无分割训练基线相当的模型效用；在对抗最先进的数据重建攻击时，始终比现有分割学习防御方法提供更强的隐私保护；且在自适应攻击设置下依然保持鲁棒性。

Conclusion: MIXGUARD有效突破了隐私保护分割学习中的效用-隐私-效率-稳定性权衡困境，为资源受限用户训练大语言模型提供了一种实用且安全的解决方案。

Abstract: Split learning provides a practical paradigm for resource-constrained users to train Large Language Models (LLMs) by offloading computation-intensive layers to a server while keeping raw data local. However, existing privacy-preserving split learning methods still face a difficult trade-off among utility, privacy, efficiency, and stability. Specifically, these methods often suffer from substantial utility degradation, remain vulnerable to advanced data reconstruction attacks, incur prohibitive computational and communication overhead, or exhibit unstable performance across different tasks. In this paper, we propose MIXGUARD, a novel mixup-based privacy-preserving split learning framework for LLMs. MIXGUARD introduces token-level obfuscation, representation-level obfuscation, and adaptive gradient perturbation mechanisms, which operate jointly to preserve useful learning signals while preventing privacy leakage to the server. Technically, MIXGUARD first constructs a lightweight calibration model on a public dataset to refine the approximated target representation, and then applies this model during privacy-preserving fine-tuning on private data. We conduct extensive experiments on four classification tasks and four text generation tasks across multiple LLM families, model sizes, architectures, and fine-tuning strategies. The results show that MIXGUARD preserves model utility comparable to non-split training baselines, consistently achieves stronger privacy protection than existing split learning defense methods against state-of-the-art data reconstruction attacks, and remains robust under adaptive attack settings.

</details>


### [357] [LLM-based Visual Code Completion for Aerospace Geometric Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16806)
*Hau Kit Yong,Robert Marsh,Edmar A. Silva,András Sóbester,Stuart E. Middleton*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于LLM的视觉编程副驾驶系统，用于航空航天工程设计任务，采用ReAct方法和GPT 5.4，并开发了Wingbuilder插件库和AVPD数据集。用户试验表明，该系统能生成有用的建议，但推理速度较慢，更适合复杂任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 航空航天行业因安全性和可解释性要求高，尚未在商业中使用基于LLM的几何设计副驾驶系统。当前缺乏针对该领域视觉编程的LLM辅助工具。

Method: 采用视觉编程变体的ReAct方法论，结合GPT 5.4构建副驾驶应用；开发Wingbuilder Grasshopper插件库用于航空航天几何抽象；构建包含18个不同难度级别专家设计任务的AVPD数据集；通过两名资深航空工程师的用户试验进行评估。

Result: ReAct视觉编程方法成功生成了参与者认为有用的建议，但推理速度较慢，限制了其在简单任务中的实用性，更适合复杂耗时的任务。参与者表示喜欢该工具并愿意在未来使用。

Conclusion: 基于LLM的视觉编程副驾驶在航空航天设计中具有潜力，但目前推理速度是主要瓶颈，需优化后方能用于更广泛的工程场景。

Abstract: Recent advances in both Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision Language Models (VLMs) have seen a step change in their ability to perform visual code completion, but the aerospace industry, which prioritizes safety and explainabilty over rapid LLM adoption, currently has no publicly announced LLM-based geometric design copilot systems in commercial use by aerospace Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs). This paper presents a LLM-based visual programming copilot application for aerospace engineering design tasks, using a visual programming variant of the ReAct methodology and GPT 5.4. In addition to the copilot, we describe Wingbuilder, a new Grasshopper plugin library with custom components for aerospace-specific geometry abstraction, and an associated Aerospace Visual Programming Dataset (AVPD) with 18 aerospace expert designed tasks at different levels of difficulty alongside ground truth solutions. We evaluate our copilot application with a user trial involving two experienced aerospace engineers from a large aircraft manufacturing company. We find our copilot visual programming ReAct methodology was successful in generating suggestions that participants found helpful, but slow ReAct inference times limit its usefulness to more complex time-consuming tasks where waiting for good copilot solution suggestion was worthwhile. Participants reported they liked the tool and would be willing to use it in the future.

</details>


### [358] [Connecting Speech to Words through Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16807)
*Gabriel Pirlogeanu,Dan Oneata,Horia Cucu,Herman Kamper*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出了一种仅通过图像及其语音描述来学习口语词汇与书面词汇映射的方法，无需文本监督。该方法利用图像字幕系统构建视觉概念的书面词汇，再通过无监督词发现技术从语音中定位目标词，最终实现口语词段与书面词的关联。在口语词检索和关键词检测任务中，该方法优于强神经基线且更具可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在没有显式文本监督的情况下，学习书面词与其口语发音之间的映射关系。

Method: 1) 使用图像字幕系统从图像中构建代表显著视觉概念的书面词表；2) 筛选包含目标词的图像字幕所对应的语音片段；3) 利用无监督词发现技术对这些语音片段进行对齐，定位目标词的实例，最终将口语词段与书面词关联起来。

Result: 在口语词检索和关键词检测实验中，所提方法优于强神经基线，且更具可解释性。

Conclusion: 该方法在英语上验证了可行性，未来可推广到缺乏转录数据的低资源语言。

Abstract: How can we learn the mapping between written words and their spoken counterparts in the absence of explicit textual supervision? We present a visually grounded method for building a vocabulary of spoken words using only images and their spoken descriptions. First, image captioning systems are used to build a vocabulary of written words representing salient visual concepts in the images. For each word, we then find utterances whose image captions contain that word. Then we use an unsupervised word discovery technique to align these utterances to locate instances of the target word. The result is spoken word segments that are linked to written words -- all accomplished without any text supervision. In spoken word retrieval and keyword spotting experiments, the proposed approach outperforms a strong neural baseline while being more interpretable. These results demonstrate the feasibility of the approach in English and motivate future work on low-resource languages without transcripts.

</details>


### [359] [Understanding the Behaviors of Environment-aware Information Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16817)
*Ruifeng Yuan,Chaohao Yuan,David Dai,Yu Rong,Hong Cheng,Hou Pong Chan,Chenghao Xiao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文首次系统分析了如何通过强化学习（RL）使LLM针对不同检索器自适应调整查询策略，发现不同检索器偏好截然不同的查询风格（如描述型vs问题型），并提出了分支式rollout技术来优化多步检索训练稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前RAG方法忽视了不同检索器需要截然不同的查询策略这一关键问题，导致固定查询策略无法在所有检索器上取得最优性能。

Method: 采用强化学习（RL）训练LLM针对不同检索器自适应调整查询生成策略；引入分支式rollout（branching-based rollout）技术处理多步检索轨迹，提升训练稳定性；结合检索器特定的人工指导与模型规模缩放来进一步增强性能。

Result: 实证表明RL能有效教会LLM针对不同检索器定制查询；不同检索器存在显著不同的最优查询风格（如描述型vs问题型）；加入检索器特定的人工指导和增大模型规模可以进一步提升性能；分支式rollout技术有效改善了多步检索场景下的训练稳定性。

Conclusion: 本文为构建真正的"检索器感知"（retriever-aware）RAG系统提供了首个实证证据和可操作的洞见。

Abstract: Recent retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) approaches have demonstrated strong capability in handling complex queries, yet current research overlooks a critical challenge: different retrievers require fundamentally different query formulation strategies for optimal performance. In this work, we present the first systematic analysis of how LLMs can learn to adapt their query formulation strategies for different retrievers via reinforcement learning (RL). Our empirical study reveals that RL effectively teaches an LLM to tailor its queries to specific retriever characteristics. We discover that different retrievers exhibit surprisingly distinct optimal query styles (e.g., descriptive vs. question-like), suggesting strategies learned for one retriever ineffective for another. We further show that performance can be enhanced by incorporating retriever-specific human guidance and by scaling model size. To facilitate learning over multi-retrieval-step trajectories, we introduce a branching-based rollout technique that improves training stability. Our work provides the first empirical evidence and actionable insights for building truly retriever-aware RAG systems. Code and resources are available at https://github.com/LCO-Embedding/Envs-aware-Information-Retrieval.

</details>


### [360] [How Much Can We Trust LLM Search Agents? Measuring Endorsement Vulnerability to Web Content Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16821)
*Yimeng Chen,Zhe Ren,Firas Laakom,Yu Li,Dandan Guo,Jürgen Schmidhuber*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出SearchGEO框架，系统评估LLM搜索代理在对抗性网页内容下的"背书腐败"漏洞，测试13个后端模型，发现攻击成功率从0%到31.4%不等，且不同模型家族的脆弱模式存在显著差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于LLM的搜索代理会将公开网页内容综合生成可操作建议，但攻击者发布的页面可能被代理转化为"背书"推荐，造成安全隐患。现有研究缺乏对这一"背书腐败"问题的系统性评估框架。

Method: 提出SearchGEO框架，包含网页证据操纵流水线、五模式攻击分类法及多输出级指标。在308个案例上评估13个LLM后端模型，并设计了将背书转化为安装命令的辅助智能体技能探测任务。

Result: 攻击成功率在Claude-Sonnet-4.6上为0.0%，在Gemini-3-Flash上高达31.4%；最强攻击模式因模型家族而异；相同部署脚手架对不同后端的ASR有放大或抑制效果；辅助探测揭示Claude过度拒绝与GPT过度信任的分裂现象。

Conclusion: 应将对抗性搜索内容下的推荐可靠性视为后端安全评估的一级维度，不同模型对背书腐败的脆弱性存在系统性差异，需针对性防御。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based search agents synthesize open-web content into actionable recommendations on behalf of users, creating a risk that attacker-published pages are transformed into endorsed claims. We introduce SearchGEO, a controlled evaluation framework for measuring endorsement corruption in LLM-based web-search agents, combining a web-evidence manipulation pipeline, a five-mode attack taxonomy, and multiple output-level metrics. We evaluate 13 LLM backends on 308 cases each. Results show that vulnerability patterns vary across backends: overall attack success rate (ASR) ranges from 0.0% on Claude-Sonnet-4.6 to 31.4% on Gemini-3-Flash, the strongest attack mode differs by model family, and the same deployment scaffold could amplify or decrease ASR on different backends. An auxiliary agent-skill probe, where endorsement becomes an install command, exposes a sharp split among otherwise robust backends: Claude over-rejects while GPT over-trusts. These findings argue for treating recommendation reliability under adversarial search content as a first-class dimension of backend safety evaluation.

</details>


### [361] [Tying the Loop -- Tied Expert Layers in Mixture-of-Experts Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16825)
*Martin Jaggi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出Expert Tying方法，通过在不同Transformer层之间共享专家参数，在保持独立路由和注意力的同时，将MoE模型的内存占用降低近2倍，且几乎不损失性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE架构中专家参数占据了绝大部分存储空间，导致训练和推理时需要巨大的内存开销，亟需一种在不显著影响性能的前提下降低内存占用的方法。

Method: 在连续的Transformer层之间共享专家参数（Expert Tying），同时保持每层独立的路由机制和注意力计算，从而减少总参数量。

Result: 在OLMoE、Qwen3和DeepSeek等主流MoE架构上的预训练实验表明，该方法可将内存占用降低近2倍，困惑度和下游任务质量几乎没有下降。

Conclusion: Expert Tying通过利用MoE路径中固有的参数冗余，实现了极优的计算-内存权衡，为下一代大语言模型的高效训练和扩展提供了新思路。

Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures efficiently scale Large Language Models (LLMs) by activating only a small fraction of their experts per token, yet the full parameter count - dominated by the expert parameters - must be held in training and inference memory. To address this, we introduce Expert Tying, an architectural modification that shares expert parameters across consecutive transformer layers while preserving independent, layer-wise routing and attention.
  We evaluate this approach across common, state-of-the-art architectures, including OLMoE, Qwen3, and DeepSeek-style MoEs. Our pretraining experiments demonstrate that tying experts can reduce memory footprint by almost 2x at virtually no degradation in perplexity or downstream quality. By exploiting the parameter redundancy inherent in MoE pathways, our method provides a highly favorable compute-to-memory trade-off, advancing efficient training and scaling of next-generation LLMs.

</details>


### [362] [Does Traversal Order Matter? A Systematic Study of Tree Traversal Methods in Transformer Grammars](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16836)
*Zongru Liu,Pengyu Ji,Pengcheng Wang,Kewei Tu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文探索了Transformer Grammars中句法树线性化的三种遍历策略（深度优先、广度优先及新型混合遍历PRT），揭示了嵌套组合与全局前瞻之间的权衡，并针对不同任务给出了可操作的建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Transformer Grammars仅使用深度优先遍历进行句法树线性化，但线性化方式对模型性能有显著影响，因此需要更系统地探索遍历策略的设计空间。

Method: 提出并实现三种遍历策略：深度优先遍历(DFT)、广度优先遍历(BFT)和新型混合遍历PRT（结合BFT的结构前瞻与DFT的早期词汇生成）；在不同树配置和掩码策略下进行实验评估。

Result: 不同遍历策略在语言建模、句法泛化和摘要任务上表现各异，揭示了嵌套组合与全局前瞻之间的固有权衡。

Conclusion: 为设计任务感知的Transformer Grammars提供了可操作的建议。

Abstract: Transformer Grammars (TGs) enhance language modeling by incorporating syntactic tree structures. Despite the potentially significant impact on model performance of how syntactic trees are linearized in TGs, existing studies rely solely on Depth-First Traversal (DFT) for linearization. In this paper, we expand the traversal design space by exploring Breadth-First Traversal (BFT) and a novel hybrid traversal strategy, Production-Rule Traversal (PRT), which combines the structural lookahead of BFT with the early lexical generation of DFT. We integrate these traversal methods with varying tree configurations and masking strategies, and empirically evaluate their performance on language modeling, syntactic generalization and summarization. We reveal the inherent trade-offs between nested composition and global lookahead, providing actionable recommendations for designing task-aware Transformer Grammars.

</details>


### [363] [Data-Driven Decoding of Russell's Circumplex Model of Affect](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16843)
*Amdjed Belaref,Samir Sadok,Zineb Noumir,Renaud Seguier*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文探究Transformer模型（RoBERTa、wav2vec 2.0及多模态融合架构）的嵌入表示是否内在编码了Russell环状模型的情感几何结构。实验表明，文本与语音的多模态融合实现了与Russell情感排序的完美拓扑对齐，且零样本通用文本嵌入中的细粒度情感词投射位置接近人工标注坐标。研究提出数据驱动的情感模型验证框架，证明环状结构是嵌入表征的内在属性而非人工标注伪影。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 情感计算依赖深度学习表示情感，但潜在空间往往是高维黑箱。本文旨在探究Transformer嵌入是否能够恢复Russell环状模型的几何规律性，从而桥接心理学理论与表示学习之间的鸿沟。

Method: 统一两个互补实验，分别在文本（RoBERTa）和语音（wav2vec 2.0）编码器及多模态Transformer融合架构上，评估深度表示是否编码与效价-唤醒一致的情感拓扑，并在MSP-Podcast自然数据集和LLM生成的控制刺激上进行验证。

Result: 多模态文本-语音融合实现了与Russell主要情感排序的完美拓扑对齐；零样本通用文本嵌入中，投射的细粒度情感词接近人工标注坐标。

Conclusion: Russell环状结构是Transformer嵌入的内在编码属性，而非单纯的人类标注伪影；提出了一种新颖的数据驱动情感模型验证框架。

Abstract: Affective computing increasingly relies on deep learning to represent emotions, yet latent spaces often remain opaque, high-dimensional black boxes. This paper investigates whether Transformers' embeddings recover the geometric regularities of Russell's circumplex model. We unify two complementary experiments testing the hypothesis that, after training models on text and speech, their resulting latent spaces encode a topology consistent with valence-arousal and reproduce human-like neighborhood relations. Specifically, we evaluate deep representations extracted from Transformer-based text (RoBERTa) and speech (wav2vec 2.0) encoders, along with a multimodal Transformer fusion architecture, across naturalistic datasets like MSP-Podcast and controlled LLM-generated stimuli. Our analysis reveals that multimodal fusion of text and audio yields perfect topological alignment with Russell's primary emotion ordering. Furthermore, in a zero-shot setting using generic text embeddings, projected fine-grained emotion terms fall close to their established human-mapped coordinates. Our contribution is a novel, data-driven framework for validating emotion models, demonstrating that Russell's circumplex structure is intrinsically encoded in the embeddings of these modalities rather than being solely an artifact of human labeling, thereby bridging the gap between psychological theory and representation learning.

</details>


### [364] [Robust Dual-Signal Fusion: Hybrid Neuro-Symbolic Gating with Compressed Chain-of-Thought Refinement for Irony Detection in Social Media Texts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16845)
*Ankit Bhattacharjee,Krityapriya Bhaumik*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出RDS混合框架，通过压缩CoT推理轨迹实现零样本讽刺检测，在TweetEval上达到78.1%准确率（与微调BERTweet持平），在iSarcasm上零样本Macro F1达0.6726，消融实验证实三信号并发融合是统计显著提升的关键。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM默认倾向于字面语义理解，零样本讽刺检测一直是一个持续存在的挑战，现有方法难以在不进行监督微调的情况下有效检测讽刺。

Method: 提出Robust Dual-Signal (RDS) Fusion框架，一种混合神经符号架构，通过压缩Chain-of-Thought (CoT)推理轨迹实现零样本讽刺检测，无需监督微调（SFT）。

Result: 在TweetEval严格留出测试集上准确率78.1%、Macro F1 0.777，与微调BERTweet天花板持平；在iSarcasm上冻结CoT管道过滤22.5%分布外幻觉，零样本Macro F1 0.6726、Ironic F1 0.4821，超越多个强监督SemEval模型。消融实验表明仅三信号并发融合达到统计显著提升（p=0.005）。

Conclusion: RDS框架通过神经符号融合有效解决了零样本讽刺检测难题，不需要监督微调即可达到甚至超越强监督方法的性能，三信号的结构性协同是关键。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) natively default to literal semantic interpretations, making zero-shot irony detection a persistent challenge. We introduce the Robust Dual-Signal (RDS) Fusion framework, a hybrid neuro-symbolic architecture that compresses Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning trajectories without Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT). Evaluated on a strictly held-out TweetEval test set (N=734), RDS achieves 78.1% accuracy and a Macro F1 of 0.777, matching the absolute performance ceiling of the fine-tuned BERTweet. On the heavily imbalanced iSarcasm dataset, the frozen CoT pipeline filters 22.5% of out-of-distribution hallucinations, yielding a zero-shot Macro F1 of 0.6726 and Ironic F1 of 0.4821, outperforming multiple heavily supervised SemEval transformer ensembles. A statistical ablation confirms this structural synergy: adding the symbolic prior to the neural baseline yields no significant gain (p = 0.242), and the marginal benefit of adding the CoT pipeline to that prior is heavily compressed (p = 0.149). Only the complete, concurrent fusion of all three signals achieves a statistically validated improvement over the baseline (p = 0.005).

</details>


### [365] [Follow the Latent Roadmap: Navigating Revocable Decoding for Diffusion LLMs with Anchor Tokens](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16847)
*Yizhen Yao,Qinglin Zhu,Runcong Zhao,Xiangxiang Dai,Yanzheng Xiang,Yulan He,Lin Gui*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出ASRD（Anchor Supervised Revocable Decoding），一种无需训练的框架，通过将解码上下文解耦为可信的锚点令牌和不确定候选令牌，缓解扩散大语言模型在并行生成中的错误传播和局部错误强化问题，在数学和编程基准上实现高达6.4%的准确率提升和7.2倍的推理加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散大语言模型（dLLMs）在并行生成中面临解码速度与质量之间的权衡。现有的可撤销解码策略在混合质量的上下文中运行，导致两种关键失败：错误传播（新令牌从错误上下文中吸收有害信息）和局部错误强化（错误相互强化以逃避检测）。

Method: ASRD是一个无需训练的框架，在嵌入空间中操作。它通过时间一致性识别可信的锚点令牌，并利用动态锚点令牌缓存，引入两种互补机制：(1) 锚点引导生成——向掩码位置注入熵加权锚点信号，隐式修正注意力朝向可靠的全局骨架；(2) 锚点扰动验证——对不确定候选令牌应用正交扰动，破坏局部脆弱共识导致的错误并重新掩码。

Result: 在数学和编程基准上的大量实验表明，ASRD优于最近的重新掩码基线，准确率提升高达6.4%，同时推理吞吐量提升高达7.2倍。

Conclusion: ASRD通过锚点监督的可撤销解码，有效解决了扩散大语言模型中的错误传播和局部错误强化问题，在提升生成质量的同时显著加速推理。

Abstract: Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) offer a promising avenue for parallel generation but face a trade-off between decoding speed and quality. While revocable decoding strategies attempt to mitigate errors by verifying and remasking tokens, they typically operate within a mixed-quality context. This leads to two critical failures: \textit{Error Propagation}, where new tokens absorb toxic information from erroneous context, and \textit{Local Error Reinforcement}, where errors mutually reinforce each other to evade detection. To alleviate these challenges, we propose ASRD (Anchor Supervised Revocable Decoding), a training-free framework that operates within the embedding space. ASRD explicitly decouples the decoding context into trusted \textit{Anchor Tokens}, which are identified via temporal consistency, and uncertain candidates. Leveraging a dynamic Anchor Tokens Cache, we introduce two complementary mechanisms: (1) Anchor-Guided Generation, which injects entropy-weighted anchor signals into masked positions to implicitly rectify attention toward the reliable global skeleton; and (2) Anchor-Perturbed Verification, which applies orthogonal perturbations to uncertain candidate tokens, destabilizing and remasking errors driven by fragile local consensus. Extensive experiments on math and coding benchmarks demonstrate that ASRD outperforms recent remasking baselines, achieving accuracy improvements of up to 6.4\% while accelerating inference throughput by up to 7.2$\times$.

</details>


### [366] [Revisiting the Systematicity in Negation in the Era of In-Context Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16867)
*Hitomi Yanaka,Taisei Yamamoto*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文从行为系统性和表征系统性两个角度分析了LLM对否定句的理解。行为上，LLM通过上下文学习能部分识别否定表达和范围，但未达完美表现，且输出格式影响范围识别难度。表征上，否定线索提取的任务向量可组合构建，但范围识别的任务向量更难提取。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究大语言模型对否定句理解存在的系统性不足，从行为和表征两个层面进行深入分析。

Method: 通过行为系统性实验（上下文学习与示例演示）和表征系统性实验（函数向量的构建与组合分析）来评估LLM的否定理解能力。

Result: LLM在否定表达和范围识别上部分有效但不完美；输出格式影响范围识别难度；否定线索提取的任务向量可组合构建，但范围识别的任务向量难以提取。

Conclusion: LLM对否定的理解存在系统性局限，尤其在否定范围识别方面，任务向量的可组合性存在差异。

Abstract: Understanding the meaning of negated sentences remains one of the challenges for language models, even in the era of large language models (LLMs). We analyze systematicity regarding LLM understanding of negation from two perspectives: behavioral systematicity and representational systematicity. For behavioral systematicity, we confirm that through demonstrations and in-context learning, LLMs can recognize negation expressions and scope within sentences to some extent, but they fail to achieve perfect performance. In particular, the difficulty of the negation scope recognition for models varies depending on the output format. For representational systematicity, we analyze the extent to which function vectors can be robustly constructed from in-context examples for tasks that are essential to understanding negation. The experiments suggest that while function vectors can be composed for negation cue extraction tasks, extracting function vectors for recognizing scope is more challenging.

</details>


### [367] [Understanding Scam Trends and Rail Paths from Reddit Self-Disclosure Narratives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16874)
*Yangjun Zhang,Mirko Bottarelli,Mark Hooper,Carsten Maple*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文构建了2023-2025年Reddit诈骗自述数据集，通过启发式标注和LLM辅助方法分析诈骗链路的多轨特征、年度趋势及社区支持行为，发现诈骗过程以多轨为主，不同诈骗类型在路径复杂度上存在系统性差异，社区支持随时间趋于详细。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究缺乏对诈骗年度趋势的追踪，且因缺少开源数据集和标注，难以分析不同诈骗类型中各个轨（身份、通信、平台、支付）之间的关系。

Method: 收集21,304条Reddit帖子用于趋势分析（启发式标注），从中筛选1,800条包含显式或可恢复诈骗链的帖子进行LLM辅助标注（结合人工评估），并对评论进行主题建模分析社区支持行为。

Result: 诈骗过程以多轨为主；不同年份和诈骗类型在轨组件上存在主导性差异；不同诈骗类型在路径复杂度上呈现系统性变化；Reddit社区支持行为随时间变得更详细。

Conclusion: 该工作支持合成诈骗链数据模拟和AI相关诈骗风险评估，但发现可能无法泛化到其他平台。

Abstract: Online scam behavior is inherently multi-stage, and the lifecycle includes temporally ordered rails and events rather than isolated signals. Existing works analyze characteristics of scam types and rails, but they do not track scam trends across years. Moreover, the work on the relations between rails is hampered due to the lack of open-source datasets with annotations and coverage of different scam types. To address these gaps, we build a dataset to analyze the yearly trend of scam characteristics and rail paths using Reddit self-disclosure narratives from 2023 to 2025. We collect 21,304 posts from scam-related subreddits with at least one rail among identity, communication, platform, and payment for trend analysis by heuristic annotation. Then, we label 1,800 posts containing explicit or recoverable scam chains by an LLM-assisted method for scam path analysis. The method is evaluated with human annotation. Lastly, we run a topic model on the comments of the posts to analyze the community support behavior. The results reveal that scam processes are predominantly multi-rail. Across years, different scam types and rail components dominate. Different scam types vary systematically in path complexity. Reddit support behaviors have become more detailed over time. This work supports synthetic scam chain data simulation and AI-related scam risk assessment, though findings may not generalise to other platforms.

</details>


### [368] [Compositional Reasoning Depth Predicts Clinical AI Failure: Empirical Evidence Consistent with Transformer Compositionality Limits in Electronic Health Record Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16890)
*Sanjay Basu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文发现LLMs在电子健康记录问答中的错误呈现系统性结构：所需推理步骤（跳数）越多，错误率越高。基于Transformer组合性局限的理论，作者提出了预定义的跳数分类法，并在多模型（Claude Sonnet、GPT-4o、GPT-5）、多设置（零样本、扩展思维）中验证了准确率随跳数单调下降的规律，扩展思维未能显著缓解此问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 聚合准确率基准掩盖了LLMs在EHR问答中失败的系统性结构，需要引入理论驱动的、可预测模型错误的细粒度指标。

Method: 提出预定义的跳数分类法（hop-count taxonomy），标注313个MedAlign问答对；在301个问题上进行组内消融（Claude Sonnet零样本 vs. 扩展思维）和跨架构复制（GPT-4o、GPT-5零样本），并进行上下文充分性审计。

Result: 所有模型准确率随跳数单调下降（Claude: 30.6%→17.6%, OR=0.72; GPT-4o: 37.8%→14.7%, OR=0.58; GPT-5: 37.8%→23.5%, OR=0.80）。扩展思维未显著平缓准确率-深度曲线，思维令牌用量与跳数正相关（r=0.31, p<0.0001）。上下文充分性审计排除了截断偏差。

Conclusion: 跳数是理论驱动、跨架构的LLM在EHR问答中错误的预测因子，可用于临床AI部署的风险分层。

Abstract: Aggregate accuracy benchmarks conceal a systematic structure in how large language models fail at electronic health record (EHR) question answering: questions requiring more inferential steps produce disproportionately more errors. Motivated by theoretical results on transformer compositionality limits, we introduce a pre-specified hop-count taxonomy -- the number of distinct reasoning steps required to answer a clinical question from an EHR -- as a principled predictor of model failure. We annotate 313 clinician-generated MedAlign EHR question-answer pairs across four hop levels and evaluate 301 questions in a within-model ablation (claude-sonnet-4-6, zero-shot vs. extended thinking) and cross-architecture replications (gpt-4o and gpt-5.4-2026-03-05, zero-shot). All three models, spanning two providers and two OpenAI generations (GPT-4 and GPT-5), show monotone accuracy decline with hop count: Claude Sonnet zero-shot falls from 30.6% (hop=1) to 17.6% (hop=4) (Cochran-Armitage z=-2.30, p=0.011; OR per hop 0.72, 95% CI [0.56,0.92], p=0.008); GPT-4o replicates this (37.8% to 14.7%; OR 0.58 [0.45,0.75], p<0.001); and gpt-5.4-2026-03-05 confirms it (37.8% to 23.5%; OR 0.80 [0.66,0.98], p=0.027). A pre-specified context-sufficiency audit shows higher-hop questions are not differentially disadvantaged by EHR truncation (answerability 93-95% at hops 2-4 vs. 79% at hop=1), so the decline reflects compositional reasoning difficulty. Extended thinking did not significantly flatten the accuracy-depth curve across three reasoning conditions, and thinking-token usage scaled with hop count (r=0.31, p<0.0001), consistent with the predicted O(k) computational requirement. Hop count is thus a theory-motivated, cross-architecture predictor of large-language-model error on EHR question answering, with direct implications for deployment risk stratification of clinical AI.

</details>


### [369] [Contrastive-Difference CKA Reveals Concept-Specific Structural Alignment Across Language Model Architectures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16897)
*Xueping Gao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出对比差分CKA（CKA_Delta）方法，发现不同LLM架构间存在“几何收敛但功能近乎完美迁移”的通用性解离现象，该方法可作为无训练的诊断工具进行跨架构概念监控。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究不同LLM架构在编码高层概念时是否存在结构上的兼容性，即跨架构的通用性（universality）程度。

Method: 提出CKA_Delta（contrastive-difference CKA），一种无训练的诊断方法，通过计算每个样本的对比差分上的核对齐，隔离概念特定的收敛与通用相似性，在标准CKA无法区分的场景下实现显著判别。

Result: 在6个概念领域（5个p≤0.017，安全性作为收敛-功能趋势p=0.08）中复现了解离现象；Gemma架构的异常检测AUC=0.79，d=1.08；单个70B-70B对提供观察性证据表明通用性可能随规模增强。

Conclusion: CKA_Delta可作为实用的跨架构概念监控的诊断工具，用于类别分类和架构异常检测，而非绝对的迁移准确性预测器。

Abstract: Do different LLM architectures encode high-level concepts in structurally compatible ways? We systematically characterize a geometric-functional universality dissociation: across multiple concept domains and architectural families, moderate geometric convergence coexists with near-perfect functional transfer. Using contrastive-difference CKA (CKA_Delta), a training-free diagnostic that computes kernel alignment on per-sample contrastive differences, we isolate concept-specific convergence from generic similarity -- achieving significant discrimination where standard CKA cannot. The dissociation replicates across all six concept domains we test (five with p <= 0.017 geometric discrimination and safety as a converging-functional trend, p = 0.08), including two non-instruction concepts (code-vs-NL, reasoning-vs-recall) validated without system prompts; a single 70B--70B pair provides an observational note that universality may strengthen with scale, requiring replication with additional >=70B models. We position CKA_Delta as a practical regime classifier and architectural outlier detector (Gemma: d = 1.08, AUC = 0.79) rather than an absolute transfer-accuracy predictor, providing a training-free diagnostic for cross-architecture concept monitoring.

</details>


### [370] [Speaking the Language of Science: Toward a General-Purpose Generative Foundation Model for the Natural Sciences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16905)
*Mingyang Li,Yurou Liu,Jieping Ye,Bing Su,Ji-Rong Wen,Zheng Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出LOGOS，一个基于共享科学语法的统一自回归语言模型，将自然科学中异构任务统一为同一框架下的下一个令牌预测，并在多种任务上匹配或超越领域专用基线，验证了"一个模型适用所有科学"的可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前AI for Science领域存在任务碎片化、模型异构化的问题，缺乏统一的基础框架。作者希望探索是否可以用一个统一的生成式语言模型来覆盖自然科学中的多种异构任务，从而推动科学基础模型与LLM在架构、训练范式和推理基础设施上的深度对齐。

Method: LOGOS将不同的科学对象及其空间相互作用编码为基于共享词汇表的令牌序列，通过离散令牌表示空间接触和约束模式，以纯序贯方式捕获复杂的结构交互，无需显式坐标或几何神经网络。所有下游任务统一表述为同一语法空间中的下一个令牌预测任务，实现多领域预训练与下游目标的对齐。

Result: 在多种任务上，LOGOS一致地匹配或超越领域专用基线。训练了1B、3B和8B三种规模模型，发现模型大小与性能之间存在一致的正相关关系。

Conclusion: 研究表明"一个模型适用所有自然科学"具有初步可行性。AI4S的未来可能不在于构建独立于LLM的技术栈，而在于通过共享架构、训练范式和推理基础设施，将科学基础模型与LLM深度对齐，使LLM成为AI4S的新入口。

Abstract: In this report, we present LOGOS (Language Of Generative Objects in Science), a scientific generative language model that unifies heterogeneous tasks across the natural sciences within a single autoregressive framework based on a shared scientific grammar. It encodes diverse scientific objects and their spatial interactions as token sequences over a common vocabulary. By representing spatial contact and constraint patterns as discrete tokens, the model captures complex structural interactions in a purely sequential manner, without relying on explicit coordinates or geometric neural networks. This unified representation enables a wide range of downstream tasks to be formulated consistently as next-token prediction in the same grammar space, creating strong alignment between continued multi-domain pre-training and downstream objectives. Across diverse tasks, LOGOS consistently matches or outperforms domain-specific baselines, providing preliminary evidence for the feasibility of "one model fits all" in the natural sciences. We train LOGOS models at different scales (1B, 3B, and 8B parameters) and find a consistent positive correlation between model size and performance. This suggests that the future of AI for Science (AI4S) may not lie in building an independent technical stack that is separated from large language models (LLMs). Instead, it may depend on deeply aligning scientific foundation models with LLMs through shared architectures, shared training paradigms, and shared inference infrastructure, so that LLMs can truly become a new entry point for AI4S. We release the model weights and associated resources to facilitate further research.

</details>


### [371] [LESS Is More: Mutual-Stability Sampling for Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16908)
*Amr Mohamed,Guokan Shang,Michalis Vazirgiannis*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: LESS是一种无需训练、与模型无关的自适应采样器，通过将令牌提交视为在线停止问题，利用互稳定性采样规则动态决定去噪步数，相比固定预算解码减少72.1%的反向步骤，同时提升平均准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散大语言模型（dLLMs）虽有优势，但现有采样程序执行固定数量的反向去噪步骤，在已稳定的位置浪费计算资源，有时又过早提交不稳定位置，限制了实际效率。

Method: 提出LESS自适应采样器，基于互稳定性规则：当某掩码位置的top-1预测置信度高、top-1令牌在最近几步中持续一致、且连续步骤间的top-K Jensen-Shannon散度稳定时，才允许该位置解掩码。

Result: 在Dream-7B、LLaDA-8B和LLaDA-1.5-8B上评估，覆盖全序列扩散和半自回归块状采样，LESS在提升平均准确率的同时，比固定预算解码减少72.1%的反向步骤，降低了延迟和推理计算量。

Conclusion: LESS作为训练无关的自适应采样方法，有效解决了dLLMs中固定步数采样的计算浪费问题，在效率和准确性之间取得了更好平衡。

Abstract: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) offer a promising alternative to autoregressive decoding by iteratively refining masked sequences, enabling parallel token updates and bidirectional conditioning. Their practical efficiency, however, is limited by sampling procedures that execute a fixed number of reverse denoising steps selected before decoding, spending computation on already-stable positions and sometimes committing unstable ones too early. We present \textsc{LESS}, a training-free, model-agnostic adaptive sampler that treats token commitment as an online stopping problem. \textsc{LESS} implements mutual-stability sampling through a joint stability rule that makes a masked position eligible for unmasking only when its top-1 prediction has high confidence, its top-1 token persists across recent reverse steps, and its predictive distribution is stable under top-$K$ inter-step Jensen--Shannon divergence. We evaluate \textsc{LESS} on Dream-7B, LLaDA-8B, and LLaDA-1.5-8B, covering full-sequence diffusion and semi-autoregressive blockwise sampling regimes, across seven benchmarks spanning general knowledge, math, and code. \textsc{LESS} improves average accuracy over strong training-free adaptive samplers while using $72.1\%$ fewer reverse steps than fixed-budget decoding. Since each reverse step requires a Transformer forward pass, these step-count reductions translate into fewer forward evaluations, lower measured wall-clock latency, and lower estimated inference compute.

</details>


### [372] [IMPACTeen: Intentions, Manipulation, Persuasion, Annotations, and Consequences in Teen Communication Dataset](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16910)
*Aleksander Szczęsny,Wiktoria Mieleszczenko-Kowszewicz,Maciej Markiewicz,Beata Bajcar,Tomasz Adamczyk,Jolanta Babiak,Grzegorz Chodak,Przemysław Kazienko*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: IMPACTeen是一个包含1,021条文本的青少年社会影响力场景数据集，涵盖人际、媒体和数字环境。每条文本从青少年、家长、心理学家、沟通专家和教师五个视角进行标注，包含影响力存在性、技巧、意图、后果、抵抗、反应及置信度等多维度标注。数据集通过受限LLM生成结合人工编辑构建，支持社会影响力检测、标注分歧、跨语言建模和语言模型评估等研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有社会影响力检测数据集缺乏青少年特定场景的多视角标注资源，且多数关注单一视角，无法捕捉不同利益相关者对影响力行为的差异化理解。研究者旨在构建一个反映青少年真实社交环境、涵盖多视角标注的社会影响力数据集，以支持更全面的社会影响分析研究。

Method: 采用受限LLM生成初始文本，经过两轮人工编辑和验证确保青少年场景的真实性。从五个不同视角（青少年、家长、心理学家、沟通专家、教师）进行多维度标注，涵盖影响力存在性、技术类型、意图、后果、抵抗策略、反应和标注置信度。数据集以波兰语创建并附有对应英语版本。

Result: 构建了包含1,021条文本、5,100条独立标注记录的多视角社会影响力数据集，覆盖人际、媒体和数字三种青少年社交情境，每条文本具备完整的七维度标注信息。

Conclusion: IMPACTeen为青少年社会影响力研究提供了首个多视角标注资源，支持影响力检测、标注分歧分析、跨语言建模及语言模型训练评估等研究方向，弥补了该领域的数据资源空白。

Abstract: IMPACTeen is a dataset of textual social influence scenarios spanning interpersonal, media-based, and digital settings in an adolescent context. It contains 1,021 texts, 5,100 individual annotation records, and gold labels for social influence techniques, with each text annotated from five distinct perspectives: teenagers, parents, psychologists, communication experts, and teachers. The resource was constructed through constrained LLM generation, followed by a two-step human editing and validation phase aimed at ensuring youth-context realism. A multi-dimensional annotation covered influence presence, techniques, intentions, consequences, resistance, reactions, and annotation confidence. The dataset supports research on social influence detection, annotator disagreement, cross-lingual modeling, and the training and evaluation of language models. The dataset was created in Polish and is accompanied by a corresponding English version.

</details>


### [373] [Exploring Extrinsic and Intrinsic Properties for Effective Reasoning with Code Interpreter](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16934)
*Patomporn Payoungkhamdee,Napat Laosaengpha,Jenta Wonglertsakul,Pittawat Taveekitworachai,Pume Tuchinda,Panjapong Poobanchuen,Ekapol Chuangsuwanich,Can Udomcharoenchaikit,Samuel Cahyawijaya,Peerat Limkonchotiwat,Sarana Nutanong*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了代码解释器（CI）增强大语言模型推理能力的行为特性，从外在关键 tokens 和内在认知行为两个角度分析了强推理模型的特征，并探索了这些特性在推理和训练阶段的利用价值与局限性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 代码解释器（CI）已被证明能有效增强LLM的推理能力，但有效代码推理的行为属性尚未被充分探索，缺乏系统性的表征研究。

Method: 从外在属性（关键tokens）和内在属性（代码专用认知行为，如验证、回溯、反向链）两个视角，在多个LLM上分析强CI推理模型的行为特征；并通过推理时追加关键tokens和训练时注入认知行为来验证这些属性的效用。

Result: 1) 强CI推理模型在关键tokens和认知行为上均表现出更高 prevalence；2) 推理时追加代码专用关键tokens在数学、排序、优化等任务上有效，但在其他任务上收益有限；3) 训练时注入认知行为在三个评估模型中的两个上提升了SFT和RL性能，同时减少了错误回答中的过度思考并提高了token效率。

Conclusion: 首次系统刻画了有效CI推理的行为特征，展示了利用关键行为属性提升CI推理能力的潜力与局限性。

Abstract: Reasoning with a Code Interpreter (CI) has emerged as an effective paradigm for enhancing the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) through executable computation and iterative verification. Despite its growing adoption, the behavioral properties underlying effective code reasoning remain largely underexplored. In this work, we investigate code reasoning from two distinct perspectives inspired by prior studies of natural language reasoning: extrinsic properties, represented by crucial tokens, and intrinsic properties, represented by code-specific cognitive behaviors. Across multiple LLMs, we find that stronger CI reasoning models consistently exhibit a higher prevalence of crucial tokens and cognitive behaviors, particularly verification, backtracking, and backward chaining. Building on these observations, we examine how these properties can be leveraged during both inference and training. At inference time, appending code-specific crucial tokens improves performance on several reasoning capabilities, including mathematical, ordering, and optimization, while yielding limited benefits elsewhere. At training time, augmenting a state-of-the-art framework with code-specific cognitive behaviors improves supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning performance in two of three evaluated models. Further analysis shows that these behaviors reduce overthinking in incorrect responses and improve token efficiency, while also revealing factors that limit gains in a certain model. Our findings provide the first systematic characterization of effective reasoning with CI and demonstrate both the potential and limitations of leveraging key properties to improve CI-based reasoning.

</details>


### [374] [TokenPilot: Cache-Efficient Context Management for LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.17016)
*Buqiang Xu,Zirui Xue,Dianmou Chen,Chenyang Fu,Chiyu Wu,Caiying Huang,Chen Jiang,Jizhan Fang,Xinle Deng,Yijun Chen,Yunzhi Yao,Xuehai Wang,Jin Shang,Gong Yu,Ningyu Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: TokenPilot是一个双粒度上下文管理框架，通过全局的Ingestion-Aware Compaction稳定提示前缀、消除噪声，以及局部的Lifecycle-Aware Eviction监控上下文段落的剩余效用并保守式卸载，在长时段LLM Agent会话中降低推理成本61%-87%，同时保持竞争性性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM Agent在长时段会话中，上下文累积导致推理成本急剧上升。现有文本剪枝或动态内存驱逐方法虽然减少了token占用，但会对序列进行不受约束的修改，改变布局，引发前缀不匹配和缓存失效问题，揭示了文本稀疏性与提示缓存连续性之间的关键权衡。

Method: 提出TokenPilot双粒度上下文管理框架：(1) 全局层面，Ingestion-Aware Compaction作为框架控制，在输入入口处稳定提示前缀并消除开放世界环境噪声；(2) 局部层面，Lifecycle-Aware Eviction监控上下文段落的持续剩余效用，采用保守的批量轮次调度，仅在任务相关性过期时才卸载内容段落。

Result: 在PinchBench和Claw-Eval数据集上，隔离模式下成本降低61%和56%，连续模式下成本降低61%和87%，同时性能与先前系统保持竞争力。

Conclusion: TokenPilot有效解决了文本稀疏性与缓存连续性之间的权衡，实现了低成本、高性能的长时段LLM Agent上下文管理，并已集成到LightMem2中开源发布。

Abstract: As LLM agents are deployed in long-horizon sessions, context accumulation drives up inference costs. Existing approaches utilize text pruning or dynamic memory eviction to minimize token footprints; however, their unconstrained sequence mutations alter layouts, introducing prefix mismatches and cache invalidation. This reveals a critical trade-off between text sparsity and prompt cache continuity. To address this, we present TokenPilot, a dual-granularity context management framework. Globally, Ingestion-Aware Compaction acts as a framework harness to stabilize prompt prefixes and eliminate open-world environmental noise at the ingestion gate. Locally, Lifecycle-Aware Eviction monitors the ongoing residual utility of context segments, enforcing a conservative batch-turn schedule to offload content segments only when task relevance expires. Experiments on PinchBench and Claw-Eval under both isolated and continuous modes demonstrate that TokenPilot reduces costs by 61% and 56% in isolated mode, and 61% and 87% in continuous mode, while maintaining competitive performance compared to prior systems. TokenPilot has been integrated into LightMem2 at https://github.com/zjunlp/LightMem2.

</details>


### [375] [DEEPRUBRIC: Evidence-Tree Rubric Supervision for Efficient Reinforcement Learning of Deep Research Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.17029)
*Minghang Zhu,Chuyang Wei,Junhao Xu,Yilin Cheng,Zhumin Chen,Jiyan He*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: DeepRubric提出了一种逆向数据构建框架，先确定证据支持的评估目标，再合成对齐的查询-评分标准对，从而获得更可靠的奖励信号。使用该框架构建9K训练样本，训练出DeepRubric-8B模型，在三个基准上达到与先前开源SOTA相当的性能，同时RL GPU训练时间减少约13倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法让LLM为给定查询生成评分标准（rubrics），但模型可能无法推断底层信息需求，导致评分标准不完整，降低强化学习效率。需要更可靠的查询-评分标准监督信号。

Method: 提出DeepRubric框架：(1) 从种子主题出发，通过递归扩展证据支持的子问题构建证据树；(2) 以证据树的叶子节点作为原子、可验证的评估目标；(3) 基于证据树合成训练查询和评分标准，确保奖励信号精确评估查询所需信息。使用该框架构建9K查询-评分标准数据，结合基于评分标准的GRPO（分组相对策略优化）训练DeepRubric-8B。

Result: DeepRubric-8B在三个基准测试上与先前开源SOTA深度研究模型性能相当，但RL GPU训练时间减少了约13倍。

Conclusion: 通过逆向构建查询-评分标准对（先确定评估目标再合成查询），可以获得更可靠的奖励信号，显著提升RL训练效率，为构建高性能深度研究智能体提供更高效的技术路径。

Abstract: Deep research agents synthesize long-form reports by searching and reasoning over retrieved evidence. Reinforcement learning with rubric-based rewards improves these agents by optimizing them against checkable criteria that translate report quality into reward signals, but its efficiency depends on whether those criteria reliably capture the task scope and evidence needs. Most existing studies ask an LLM to generate rubrics for a given query, but when the model fails to infer the underlying information needs, the generated rubrics may be incomplete and reduce RL efficiency. To obtain more reliable query--rubric supervision, we introduce DeepRubric, a data construction framework that reverses this process: instead of inferring evaluation criteria for a given query, it first determines what an evidence-backed report should be evaluated on and then synthesizes aligned query--rubric pairs from those evaluation targets. Starting from a sampled seed topic, DeepRubric builds an evidence tree by recursively expanding evidence-backed sub-questions, whose leaves serve as atomic and verifiable evaluation targets. It then uses the evidence tree to synthesize the training query and rubrics, ensuring that the reward evaluates exactly the information requested by the query. Using DeepRubric, we construct 9K query--rubric supervision examples and train DeepRubric-8B with rubric-based GRPO, achieving comparable performance to prior open state-of-the-art deep research models across three benchmarks with roughly 13x fewer RL GPU-hours.

</details>


### [376] [KVEraser: Learning to Steer KV Cache for Efficient Localized Context Erasing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.17034)
*Mufei Li,Shikun Liu,Dongqi Fu,Haoyu Wang,Yinglong Xia,Hong Li,Hong Yan,Pan Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: KVEraser是一种基于学习的KV缓存编辑方法，通过在KV缓存中仅替换被删除区间的状态为学习到的引导状态，实现高效的局部上下文擦除，在性能接近全量重计算的同时，延迟仅增加24%（对比全量重计算的17.6倍增长）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文LLM应用中，事后发现需要删除的上下文区间（如过时检索事实、错误工具观测、撤回的用户偏好或有害提示注入）时，局部编辑会因KV缓存的全局依赖性导致后续所有token的状态被污染。精确擦除需要重算删除区间后的所有token，计算成本与后缀长度成正比而非删除区间长度，效率极低。

Method: 提出KVEraser方法：1) 仅替换KV缓存中被删除区间的状态为学习到的引导状态（steering states），保留其余缓存不变；2) 设计两阶段训练流程：通用跨度-邻居预训练（学习抑制被删除区间影响）+ 任务特定微调（适配下游场景）。

Result: 在1K-32K上下文长度的域内任务上，后擦除性能接近全量重计算；延迟仅增加24%（对比全量重计算的17.6倍）；在未见过的长文档QA任务中，对有害事实干扰物的处理达到最佳近似性能，同时实现3-4倍加速。

Conclusion: KVEraser有效解决了KV缓存中局部上下文擦除的全局影响问题，在保持高性能的同时显著降低计算开销，并具有良好的泛化能力。

Abstract: Post-hoc context erasing over the KV cache is challenging because a local edit has a global consequence: once a span has been processed, its influence propagates into the cached states of all subsequent tokens. This issue arises naturally in long-context LLM applications, where stale retrieved facts, incorrect tool observations, retracted user preferences, or harmful prompt injections may be identified only after prefill. Exact erasing must then recompute all tokens after the deleted span, making its computational cost depend on suffix length rather than erased-span length. We introduce KVEraser, a learned KV-cache editing method for efficient localized context erasing. Given a processed context and a span to remove, KVEraser replaces only the KV states of the erased interval with learned steering states while reusing the remaining cache unchanged. To learn a transferable erasing mechanism, we build a two-stage training pipeline: generic span-neighbor pre-training teaches the eraser to suppress the influence of the erased span, while task-specific fine-tuning adapts this capability to downstream scenarios. Experiments show that KVEraser nearly matches full recomputation in post-erasure performance on in-domain tasks across 1K--32K context lengths, while its latency increases by only 24% compared with a 17.6x increase for full recomputation. KVEraser also generalizes to unseen long-document QA tasks with harmful factual distractors, achieving the best performance among approximate baselines with a 3--4x speedup over full recomputation.

</details>


### [377] [Benchmarking LLM Agents on Meta-Analysis Articles from Nature Portfolio](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.17041)
*Anzhe Xie,Weihang Su,Yujia Zhou,Yiqun Liu,Qingyao Ai*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: MetaSyn是一个包含442个专家策划元分析的数据集，用于评估系统化科学推理能力。基准测试显示，尽管检索上限达90.9%召回率，但所有系统最多仅能恢复52.7%的纳入文献，表明当前LLM在PI/ECO筛选环节存在严重瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 元分析具有结构化、可验证的工作流，是评估系统化科学推理的理想载体，但现有基准缺乏覆盖完整检索-筛选-综合管线的真实标注数据。

Method: 构建MetaSyn数据集：442个来自Nature Portfolio期刊的元分析，每个条目包含研究问题、PI/ECO标准、14万PubMed文章的检索语料库、已验证阳性研究、主题相似但不符合PI/ECO的硬负样本、完整搜索策略及日期范围。对12种管线配置（9种RAG变体+1个协议驱动智能体）进行基准测试。

Result: 检索上限在K=200时达90.9%召回率，但所有系统恢复的纳入文献不超过52.7%。当前LLM无法可靠地将符合PI/ECO的研究与主题相关的干扰项区分开。

Conclusion: 筛选环节是当前系统的主要瓶颈；分阶段归因指标比单一端到端评分更能揭示系统成功与失败的位置。

Abstract: Meta-analysis is a demanding form of evidence synthesis that combines literature retrieval, PI/ECO-guided study selection, and statistical aggregation. Its structured, verifiable workflow makes it an ideal substrate for evaluating systematic scientific reasoning, yet existing benchmarks lack ground truth across the full retrieval-screening-synthesis pipeline. We introduce MetaSyn, a dataset of 442 expert-curated meta-analyses from Nature Portfolio journals. Each entry pairs a research question with PI/ECO criteria, a retrieval corpus of 140k PubMed articles, verified positive studies, hard negatives that are topically similar but PI/ECO-ineligible, and complete search strategies and date bounds.
  Benchmarking twelve pipeline configurations (nine RAG variants and a protocol-driven agent) reveals a critical screening bottleneck: despite a retrieval ceiling of 90.9% recall at K=200, no system recovers more than 52.7% of ground-truth included literature. Current LLMs fail to reliably separate eligible studies from PI/ECO-failing distractors in pools of comparable topical relevance. Stage-attributed metrics capture where systems succeed and fail; a single end-to-end score does not.

</details>


### [378] [Context-Aware RL for Agentic and Multimodal LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.17053)
*Peiyang Xu,Bangzheng Li,Sijia Liu,Karthik R. Narasimhan,Pramod Viswanath,Prateek Mittal,Xingyu Fu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出ContextRL方法，通过间接辅助目标（上下文选择任务）增强LLM在长上下文和复杂多模态场景中的细粒度推理能力，在编程智能体和多模态推理任务上分别获得+2.2%和+1.8%的平均提升，并通过消融实验证明收益来自目标函数设计而非额外数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在处理长上下文或复杂多模态输入时，往往难以捕捉其中微小但关键的证据（如工具轨迹中的单行信息或图像中的细微细节），导致推理失败。现有方法主要关注最终答案的监督，缺乏对细粒度上下文理解的直接激励。

Method: 提出ContextRL，一种上下文感知的强化学习方法。核心创新在于一个间接辅助目标：给定查询、答案和两个高度相似的上下文（一个支持QA对，一个不支持），模型通过选择正确上下文获得奖励，从而鼓励细粒度上下文推理。数据构建涵盖两个领域：1) 编码智能体领域，通过条件过滤构建1k对轨迹上下文；2) 多模态推理领域，通过生成式编辑和相似性搜索构建7k对图像上下文。该方法在GRPO框架上实现。

Result: 在5个长程推理基准上平均提升+2.2%（相对于标准GRPO），在12个多样化VQA基准上平均提升+1.8%。消融实验表明，仅将相同对比数据作为标准查询-上下文-答案示例进行数据增强无法带来显著提升，验证了收益来源于上下文选择目标函数设计。

Conclusion: ContextRL通过间接的上下文选择辅助目标，有效提升了LLM在长上下文和复杂多模态场景下的细粒度推理能力，且收益主要来自目标函数设计而非额外训练数据本身。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) often fail when answering requires identifying a small but decisive piece of evidence within a long or complex context, such as a single line in a tool trace or a subtle detail in an image. We propose ContextRL, a context-aware reinforcement learning (RL) method that improves long-horizon reasoning and multimodal performance through an \emph{indirect} auxiliary objective. Instead of supervising only the final answer, ContextRL presents the model with a query, an answer, and two highly similar contexts, and rewards it for selecting the context that supports the query--answer pair, thereby encouraging fine-grained grounding. We construct contrastive context data in two domains: for coding agents, trajectories serve as contexts, yielding 1k pairs built via condition filtering; for multimodal reasoning, images serve as contexts, yielding 7K pairs built via generative editing and similarity search. ContextRL achieves average gains of +2.2% over standard GRPO on 5 long-horizon benchmarks, and +1.8% across 12 diverse visual question answering benchmarks. To disentangle the effect of the proposed objective from that of additional data, we compare against data-augmentation baselines that repurpose the same contrastive contexts as standard query--context--answer examples. These baselines provide little to no improvement, showing that the gains arise from the proposed context-selection objective rather than from the contrastive data alone.

</details>


### [379] [The Value Axis: Language Models Encode Whether They're on the Right Track](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.17056)
*Nick Jiang,Isaac Kauvar,Jack Lindsey*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文发现语言模型（Qwen3-8B）内部存在一个线性编码的"价值轴"，用于追踪当前轨迹达成目标的预期成功率。该价值轴与置信度、回溯行为、代码质量等密切相关，通过干预可控制模型行为（如抑制自我修正、诱导回溯），且直接偏好优化（DPO）可提升奖励行为的内部价值。研究还发现该价值轴在后训练中会降低对政治敏感查询的估值，监督微调则提升训练域内的内部置信度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究语言模型是否在内部追踪当前策略达成目标的预期成功率（即"价值"），以及这种内部价值表征如何影响模型的置信度、自我修正、回溯探索等行为。

Method: 使用合成上下文强化学习数据构建Qwen3-8B的价值轴；通过激活干预（steering）沿该轴操控模型行为；采用直接偏好优化（DPO）提升奖励行为的内部价值；在多种场景（置信度表达、回溯行为、代码质量、政治敏感查询、监督微调）中验证价值轴的作用。

Result: 价值轴激活能区分高低置信度、有无回溯行为、正确与错误代码；向高价值方向干预抑制自我修正并减少解释冗余，向低价值方向干预诱导回溯和探索；DPO可提升奖励行为的内部价值使模型表现更自信；后训练中模型对政治敏感查询分配低价值；监督微调提升训练域内内部置信度。

Conclusion: 语言模型内部线性编码了一个预期目标成功率的估计值，该价值表征调制模型对当前行为方向的置信度，且可通过训练手段（如DPO）进行修改。

Abstract: We investigate whether language models internally track the value of their current trajectory, defined as the likelihood that their ongoing strategy will achieve their goals. Using synthetic, in-context reinforcement learning data, we construct a "value" axis for Qwen3-8B. We find that activations along this axis distinguish between high vs. low verbalized confidence, rollouts without and with backtracking, and correct vs. corrupted code. Steering towards high value causally suppresses self-correction and reduces explanatory verbosity, while steering towards low value induces backtracking and exploration. We demonstrate that direct preference optimization (DPO) can increase the internal value of rewarded behaviors (e.g. use a certain word), causing the model to act more confidently after exhibiting them. Finally, we apply the value axis to study in-the-wild settings. For example, we find that Qwen assigns low value to politically sensitive chat queries after post-training and that supervised fine-tuning increases internal confidence within the training domain. Our results suggest that language models linearly encode an estimate of expected goal success that modulates their confidence in pursuing a direction.

</details>

# cs.GR [[Back]](#toc)

### [380] [DC-Motion: Decoupling Semantics and Details via Discrete-Continuous Tokens for Human Motion Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.14721)
*Hequan Wang,Jiaxu Zhang,Zhengbo Zhang,Zhigang Tu*

Main category: cs.GR

TL;DR: DC-Motion提出了一种离散-连续因子化生成框架，通过DC-VAE将人体运动分解为离散语义令牌和连续物理残差，结合掩码自回归模型和轻量级残差扩散模型，在HumanML3D和KIT-ML上实现了SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于同质表示空间的方法（扩散模型在组合语义推理上表现不佳，自回归模型因量化损失物理细节）难以同时捕捉运动的层次化语义结构和细粒度物理动态，亟需一种能显式解耦语义与细节的生成框架。

Method: 提出DC-Motion框架：1) DC-VAE将运动分解为离散令牌（语义）和连续残差（细粒度动态）；2) 掩码自回归模型从文本预测离散结构；3) 轻量级残差扩散模型恢复连续物理细节。

Result: 在HumanML3D和KIT-ML数据集上达到SOTA，在FID（运动真实感）和R-precision（文本对齐）两个指标上均为最优。

Conclusion: DC-Motion通过离散-连续双空间因子化解耦，有效平衡了语义可控性与物理真实感，为人体运动生成提供了一种高度适应性的建模范式。

Abstract: Text-to-motion generation requires synthesizing physically realistic dynamics that strictly follow complex and long-horizon textual instructions. Existing approaches rely on homogeneous representation spaces that may fail to capture the hierarchical nature of human motion, with diffusion models struggling at compositional semantic reasoning and AR models sacrificing fine-grained physical details due to quantization. To solve it, we introduce DC-Motion, a factorized generative framework designed to explicitly decouple semantics and details via discrete-continuous tokens. A Discrete-Continuous VAE (DC-VAE) first decomposes motion into discrete tokens for semantics and continuous residuals for fine-grained dynamics. Then, a masked AR model predicts the discrete structure from text, and a lightweight residual diffusion model recovers the continuous physical details. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DC-Motion effectively improves the capability to follow complex instructions. By effectively balancing semantic controllability and physical realism, our approach offers a highly adaptable modeling paradigm for human motion generation. On both HumanML3D and KIT-ML datasets, DC-Motion achieves state-of-the-art performance, delivering the best FID for motion realism and R-precision for text alignment.

</details>


### [381] [Toward Richer Material Generation via Procedural Data Enhancement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.14988)
*Yunchen Yu,Jacob Munkberg,Jon Hasselgren,Chris Cummings,Steve Marschner,Andrea Weidlich*

Main category: cs.GR

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种从简单PBR材料增强到更具表现力的多层材质的流程，通过构造多瓣非漫射分量并编码为神经材质（共享6D潜空间），用于训练生成模型，并通过微调视频扩散模型生成神经潜纹理来验证可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有用于材质创建的生成模型受限于训练数据的质量和表现力——简单的PBR材质（漫射项+单瓣高光）无法捕捉真实材料中许多重要的视觉效果。

Method: 从简单PBR材质出发，基于物理先验过程式地构造对应的多瓣非漫射分量（覆盖灰尘、清漆、分层散射等效果）；将该非漫射分量编码为神经材质，采用共享的6D潜空间，每个材质实例由两个潜纹理表示并通过预训练的通用MLP解码；对潜空间进行正则化以支持材质生成；最后微调视频扩散模型来生成编码多瓣材质的神经潜纹理。

Result: 生成的神经材质数据集能够支持更丰富材质的生成模型训练；通过微调视频扩散模型生成神经潜纹理，展示了生成结果作为可行性证明。

Conclusion: 所提出的过程式数据增强方法是提高材质生成表现力的重要一步。

Abstract: Generative models for material creation are fundamentally limited by the quality and expressivity of available training data. Simple physically based rendering (PBR) materials, which combine a diffuse term with a single-lobe specular component, are commonly used for training but are insufficient to capture many important visual effects present in real materials.
  We present a method that enhances such simple PBR materials to more expressive ones, by augmenting the single GGX specular lobe into a layered model that captures a broader range of non-diffuse effects. Starting from a simple material, we procedurally construct a corresponding multi-lobe non-diffuse component guided by physical priors, enabling effects such as dust, clearcoat, and layered scattering. To provide a compact representation for downstream applications, we encode this non-diffuse component as a neural material with a shared 6D latent space, where each material instance is represented by two latent textures and decoded by a pretrained universal MLP. We further regularize the latent space to support material generation.
  The resulting neural material dataset enables training generative models for richer material creation. To demonstrate this application, we finetune a video diffusion model to produce neural latent textures that encode our multi-lobe material, and present generative results as proof of feasibility. Our procedural data enhancement approach is an important step toward improving expressivity in material generation.

</details>


### [382] [HairLRM: Strand-based Hair Modeling via Large Reconstruction Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15238)
*Yuefan Shen,Yican Dong,Xiufeng Huang,Zhongtian Zheng,Youyi Zheng,Kui Wu*

Main category: cs.GR

TL;DR: 针对传统基于发丝建模的ill-posed问题（从2D图像推断3D毛发场缺乏结构约束），本文通过将大重建模型（LRM）的强几何先验集成到发丝生成管线中，利用LRM网格作为结构锚点，并设计双方向自编码器将粗几何提升为高保真发丝，通过在潜空间优化和表面引导精修解决矢量场奇点，有效解缠复杂拓扑结构，在毛发重建鲁棒性和精度上达到新标杆。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统发丝建模的根本限制不是数据稀缺，而是从2D图像推断复杂3D场缺乏结构约束导致的ill-posed问题，这种无约束回归会在全局遮挡（如马尾辫）和局部方向性（如卷发）上产生灾难性失败，生成过度平滑但几何不正确的结果。

Method: 1) 将大重建模型（LRM）的强几何先验集成到发丝生成管线中；2) 使用LRM网格作为结构锚点；3) 设计双方向自编码器（Dual Orientation AutoEncoder）将粗几何提升为高保真发丝；4) 通过潜空间优化和表面引导精修来解矢量场奇点。

Result: 有效解缠复杂拓扑结构，在毛发重建的鲁棒性和精度上达到新基准。

Conclusion: 本文方法通过引入LRM几何先验和双方向自编码器，解决了传统发丝建模中因缺乏结构约束导致的ill-posed问题，实现了从2D图像到高保真3D发丝的鲁棒重建。

Abstract: The fundamental limitation of traditional strand-based modeling is not simply data scarcity, but the ill-posedness of inferring complex 3D fields from 2D imagery without structural constraints. This unconstrained regression leads to catastrophic failures in resolving both global occlusion (e.g., in ponytails) and local directionality (e.g., in curls), resulting in over-smoothed, plausible-but-incorrect geometries. To resolve this, we integrate the strong geometric priors of Large Reconstruction Models (LRMs) into the strand generation pipeline. Using the LRM mesh as a structural anchor, we employ a novel Dual Orientation AutoEncoder to lift coarse geometry into high-fidelity strands. By resolving vector field singularities through latent-space optimization and surface-guided refinement, our method effectively disentangles complex topological structures, setting a new benchmark for robustness and accuracy in hair reconstruction.

</details>


### [383] [Walking on Heat Stars for Parabolic Heat Equations with Neumann Boundary Conditions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16578)
*Anchang Bao,Enya Shen,Jianmin Wang*

Main category: cs.GR

TL;DR: 本文提出了Walk on Heat Stars，一种无网格蒙特卡洛求解器，通过将Walk on Stars的边界积分框架扩展到抛物型方程，利用热球抽样的非圆柱边界积分公式及Gamma-均匀分解实现精确方向重要性采样，并推导了去耦梯度估计器和时空异方差回归降噪器，在多种几何和边界条件下验证了收敛性和实用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 蒙特卡洛方法在椭圆型偏微分方程求解中表现优异（如Walk on Spheres和Walk on Stars），但将其扩展到瞬态（抛物型）区域一直是一个开放挑战：抛物型方程通过各向异性缩放耦合空间和时间，需要联合采样空间位移和反向时间步长，而此前缺乏统一、精确的分布形式。

Method: 1) 将Walk on Stars的边界积分框架扩展到抛物型设置，提出非圆柱边界积分公式以适应热球采样引起的时间变化域；2) 热球几何通过对数时间坐标和空间方向参数化，发现双层核可分解为独立的Gamma分布和均匀分布分量，从而实现精确方向重要性采样；3) 推导去耦梯度估计器，将空间导数表达为解的加权边界积分，无需对梯度进行递归；4) 采用基于异方差回归的降噪器进行时空方差缩减。

Result: 在多种几何形状和空间频率的分析解上验证了方法，确认了预期的蒙特卡洛收敛速率，并在具有混合或纯Neumann边界条件的散热器和冷却场景中展示了实际应用能力。

Conclusion: 该方法填补了蒙特卡洛方法在瞬态抛物型PDE领域的空白，实现了无网格、无全局线性求解的精确求解，并具备梯度估计和方差缩减能力，具有实际工程应用价值。

Abstract: Monte Carlo methods have proven highly effective for elliptic partial differential equations through algorithms such as Walk on Spheres and Walk on Stars, which evaluate solutions at individual points without volumetric meshing or global linear solves. Extending these methods to the transient regime has remained an open challenge: parabolic equations couple space and time through an anisotropic scaling, requiring joint sampling of spatial displacements and backward time steps whose distribution was not previously available in a unified, exact form.
  We present Walk on Heat Stars, a grid-free Monte Carlo solver that closes this gap by extending the boundary integral framework of Walk on Stars to the parabolic setting. Our method introduces a non-cylindrical boundary integral formulation that accommodates the time-varying domains induced by heat-ball sampling. The heat ball geometry is parameterized by a logarithmic time coordinate and a spatial direction, revealing that the double-layer kernel factorizes into independent Gamma and uniform components. This factorization enables exact directional importance sampling of the recursive next walk position, the Neumann flux contribution, and the volumetric source term.
  We further derive a decoupled gradient estimator that expresses spatial derivatives as weighted boundary integrals of the solution, requiring no recursion on the gradient, and adapt a heteroscedastic regression-based denoiser to the space-time domain for variance reduction. We validate our method on analytical solutions across a range of geometries and spatial frequencies, confirm convergence at the expected Monte Carlo rate, and demonstrate practical applicability on heat sink and cooling scenes with mixed or pure Neumann boundary conditions.

</details>


### [384] [STAR-NT: Spatiotemporal Acceleration of Real-Time Neural Transparency Rendering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16747)
*Grigoris Tsopouridis,Christos Georgiou-Mousses,Aris Panagiotidis,Andreas Vasilakis,David Corrigan,Tobias A. Franke,Aleksei Gorbonosov,Andrei Astapov,Ioannis Fudos*

Main category: cs.GR

TL;DR: 提出了一种时空加速框架，通过自适应四叉树屏幕空间细分（空间）和深度重投影帧复用（时间），降低神经顺序无关透明度的几何开销和网络输入生成成本，在移动和旧硬件上保持视觉质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经顺序无关透明度（Neural OIT）虽能高质量渲染重叠透明表面，但其几何通道和网络输入生成计算开销过大，尤其在移动端和旧硬件上难以实用。

Method: 空间上采用自适应四叉树屏幕空间细分，根据局部颜色方差动态调整几何通道分辨率；时间上对选定帧通过深度重投影复用上一帧的透明度结果，避免完整重新渲染。

Result: 显著降低了渲染开销，同时保持了视觉质量，且能高效集成到现有实时渲染管线中。

Conclusion: 所提出的时空加速框架能有效解决神经OIT在移动和旧硬件上的性能瓶颈，兼顾效率与质量，具有良好的管线兼容性。

Abstract: Neural order-independent transparency delivers high-quality rendering of overlapping transparent surfaces, but its geometry passes and network input generation remain costly, particularly on mobile and legacy hardware. We present a spatiotemporal acceleration framework that exploits spatial and temporal coherence to reduce this overhead while preserving visual quality. Spatially, we use adaptive quadtree-based screen-space subdivision to scale geometry pass resolution according to local color variance. Temporally, selected frames reuse the previous transparency result through depth-based reprojection instead of full rendering. Together, these optimizations reduce rendering cost and integrate efficiently into existing real-time rendering pipelines.

</details>


### [385] [AI+CAD Data Representation Architecture: From AI+CAD Solid Modeling to AI+CAD Industrial-Grade Parametric Feature Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16797)
*Rubin Fan,Fazhi He,Yuxin Liu,Jing Lin,Ruibo Wan,Xuecheng Zhang,Qingchen Kong*

Main category: cs.GR

TL;DR: 本文分析了中国工业软件在R&D设计领域依赖进口（95%）及高端CAD/CAE/CAM市场被欧美垄断（90%）的战略瓶颈问题，指出CAD与CV/CG不同，更强调“工业可用性”且数据表示架构比网络算法优化更基础。文章从AI+CAD数据表示出发，分类阐述研究进展，以DeepCAD为例分析其与工业级参数化特征建模的差距，通过对比WHUCAD的三级架构说明其对工业级建模的基础支撑作用，最后展望了AI大模型与智能体在工业级CAD中的应用前景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 中国工业软件在研发设计领域严重依赖进口，高端CAD市场被欧美垄断，形成战略瓶颈。同时，现有AI+CAD研究多追求视觉逼真度而非工业可用性，数据表示架构设计不足，难以支撑工业级参数化特征建模，急需系统梳理现状、识别差距、探索可行路径。

Method: 采用分类梳理与对比分析方法：首先对AI+CAD数据表示进行分类并综述研究进展；然后以DeepCAD数据表示为例剖析代表性工作的痛点及其与工业级建模的差距；接着与WHUCAD三级数据表示架构进行对比，论证其对工业级参数化特征建模的基础支撑作用；最后基于AI大模型与智能体的发展趋势进行展望。

Result: 识别出AI+CAD领域的关键瓶颈：现有工作（如DeepCAD）的数据表示不足以支持工业级参数化特征建模；而WHUCAD的三级架构（几何基元级、特征操作级、参数约束级）为工业级建模提供了更完备的数据表示基础；同时指出在AI大模型和智能体快速迭代背景下，工业级CAD的AI化仍面临数据表示与工业可用性之间的根本性鸿沟。

Conclusion: 工业级CAD的AI化必须超越视觉逼真度导向，回归“工业可用性”这一核心目标，其中数据表示架构的设计比网络模型优化更具根本性。WHUCAD的三级架构展示了可行方向，但还需在AI大模型与智能体时代持续迭代，以真正弥合AI技术与工业级参数化特征建模之间的差距。

Abstract: In July 2025, Study Times, sponsored by the Party School of the Central Committee of the CPC, pointed out that 95% of industrial software for R&D and design in China relies on imports, and that 90% of the high-end CAD/CAE/CAM software market is monopolized by European and American giants. This is a typical strategic bottleneck problem. Unlike the visually oriented goal of "visual plausibility" pursued by related sister disciplines such as CV and CG, CAD places greater emphasis on "industrial usability". In CAD, data representation architecture is more foundational than the optimization of network algorithms. This paper first starts from data representation in AI+CAD and reports a classification paradigm and research progress in AI+CAD. Then, using the open-source DeepCAD data representation as an example, it analyzes the pain points of representative AI+CAD work and the gap between such work and real industrial-grade parametric feature modeling. Next, by comparison with the open-source WHUCAD data representation, it discusses how its three-level architecture provides fundamental support for industrial-grade parametric feature modeling. Finally, in view of the rapid iteration of the AI wave, large models, and agents, this paper offers an outlook on AI+industrial-grade CAD.

</details>

### [386] [A Definition of Good Explanations and the Challenges Explaining LLM Outputs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.14838)
*Louis Mahon,Elliot Ford,Callum Hackett*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于反事实解释的AI可解释性定义，强调需考虑对话者对解释中每个事实的先验信念，并探讨了该定义对AI可解释性的影响，特别是为何LLM输出难以产生良好解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长期以来关于"何为良好解释"的哲学争论在AI输出的背景下重新引起关注。可解释性对AI在许多场景中的采用至关重要，但在生成AI系统的良好解释之前，必须首先理解什么是良好解释。

Method: 受反事实解释概念的启发，提出了一种新的解释定义，但在该定义中，还需考虑对话者对可提供解释的每个事实的先验信念。

Result: 该定义对AI可解释性产生了重要影响，特别是在解释为什么LLM输出难以产生良好解释方面。

Conclusion: 良好的AI解释不仅需要反事实推理，还需要建模用户的先验信念，而这正是LLM场景中难以实现的挑战。

Abstract: How to define a good explanation is a long-standing philosophical debate which has found recent renewed interest in the context of AI outputs. Explainability is crucial for AI adoption in many contexts, but in order to produce good explanations of AI systems, we must first have an understanding of what good explanations are. In this paper we propose a definition inspired by the notion of counterfactual explanations, however we argue that one must also take into account the interlocutor's prior beliefs in each fact that could be offered in an explanation. We explore the ramifications of this definition for AI explainability and, in particular, why LLM outputs are difficult to produce good explanations for.

</details>


### [387] [Dr-DCI: Scaling Direct Corpus Interaction via Dynamic Workspace Expansion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.14885)
*Yi Lu,Zhuofeng Li,Ping Nie,Haoxiang Zhang,Yuyu Zhang,Kai Zou,Wenhu Chen,Jimmy Lin,Dongfu Jiang,Yu Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: DR-DCI是一种检索器引导的局部工作空间框架，它将检索作为智能体可调用的动作，在动态扩展的工作空间内执行直接语料库交互（DCI）操作，平衡了检索的可扩展性和DCI的精确性，在多个基准上提升了准确率并降低了成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的检索器介导接口（如BM25、ColBERT）虽然能高效排序相关文档，但只能提供排名结果或有限文档视图，限制了智能体重组材料和跨文档验证约束的能力。直接语料库交互（DCI）虽然解决了这一问题，但随着语料库增大，全语料终端命令变得缓慢且不稳定。

Method: 提出DR-DCI框架，将检索作为智能体可调用的动作，从全语料库中动态拉取相关文档到局部工作空间，在工作空间内执行DCI操作（搜索、过滤、比较、验证）。结合了检索层的召回能力和DCI风格的精确操作，并支持工作空间保留的上下文重置。

Result: 在Browsecomp-Plus上达到71.2%准确率，比原始DCI和消融变体提升8.3个百分点，同时减少工具使用、墙钟时间和预估成本。工作空间保留的上下文重置进一步提升至73.3%。在从10万到1000万文档的语料规模实验中保持有效，而原始DCI变得不稳定、BM25表现大幅下降。在2000万规模的Wiki-18 QA场景中平均得分63.0，超越基于检索和经过训练的搜索智能体基线。

Conclusion: DR-DCI通过将检索与局部工作空间DCI操作相结合，有效解决了大规模语料下直接交互的性能瓶颈，实现了跨规模的有效性和高效性。消融分析表明，排名预览和文档间DCI是性能的关键因素。

Abstract: Agentic search over large corpora relies on retriever-mediated interfaces (e.g., BM25 or ColBERT) for scalable candidate discovery. While effective at ranking relevant documents, these interfaces expose evidence only as ranked results or bounded document views, limiting agents' ability to reorganize material and verify constraints across documents. Direct Corpus Interaction (DCI) addresses this limitation by exposing shell-executable corpus operations for flexible search, filtering, comparison, and verification. However, full-corpus terminal commands become slow and unstable as the corpus grows, degrading performance and efficiency. We introduce DR-DCI, a retriever-steered DCI framework that treats retrieval as an agent-callable action for expanding a local workspace. Rather than operating directly over the full corpus, the agent dynamically pulls relevant documents into an evolving workspace and conducts DCI operations within it. This design combines retriever-level recall with DCI-style precision: retrieval keeps exploration scalable, while DCI preserves the local operations needed for effective evidence resolution. Experiments show that DR-DCI is both effective and efficient across scales. On Browsecomp-Plus, DR-DCI reaches 71.2\% accuracy, improving over raw DCI and ablated variants by up to 8.3 points while reducing tool usage, wall time, and estimated cost. With workspace-preserving context reset, accuracy further improves to 73.3\%. In corpus-scaling experiments, DR-DCI remains effective from 100K to 10M documents, whereas raw DCI becomes unstable and BM25 performs substantially worse. DR-DCI also scales to a 20M-scale file-per-document Wiki-18 QA setting, achieving an average score of 63.0 across six benchmarks and outperforming retrieval-based and trained search-agent baselines. Ablation analysis further shows that ranked previews and inter-document DCI are key to performance.

</details>


### [388] [Relational Structural Causal Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.14892)
*Adiba Ejaz,Elias Bareinboim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出关系结构因果模型，将结构因果模型扩展到对象和关系可变的场景，并证明在无额外假设下无法识别关于未见对象组合的因果和观测查询；通过定义关系因果图推导符号识别准则，并提出关系神经因果模型，在交通场景模拟中优于非关系基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI需要具备因果性（支持干预和反事实推理）和组合性（泛化到未见过的对象组合），但现有因果模型无法处理对象和关系变化的情况，因此需要正式研究何时以及如何学习这样的模型。

Method: 1) 提出关系结构因果模型，扩展标准SCM以支持可变的对象和关系；2) 定义关系因果图，推导符号识别准则以实现在存在未观测混杂情况下的识别；3) 提出关系神经因果模型作为可证明正确的实现方法。
